186000.description:
Sakurai Fumihiko is introduced to his best friend Iijima Takumi’s new boyfriend — Kai Tooru. Having always thought of himself as Takumi’s protector, Fumihiko feels a bit of bittersweet relief, as if his help is no longer needed. Kai’s friend, Nanbu Yoshitaka, joins their group, and the four start spending more time together. But when Nanbu confesses his feelings for Fumihiko, Fumihiko realizes that it’s actually Kai, his best friend’s boyfriend, who has captured his heart. Keeping his feelings quietly to himself, Fumihiko tries to continue his life like normal. But a dark shadow from his past creeps closer, and when Fumihiko unexpectedly discovers Kai’s hidden side, he comes up with a plan to make his own desires come true.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Incudes two extra chapters.

186001.description:
When Lu Chen entered the world of the quantum-neural VR game "Empyrean God Realm" — he found himself stripped of his human character, instead he became the weakest monster in the game, a "Gnoll Weakling." Faced with player characters who are ready to kill him to level up, Lu Chen must take up his broken gnoll club and fight to level up, starting from a Level 1 Gnoll. As Lu Chen keeps on killing more and more types of monsters, he gains new talents and level them up, and his powers keep getting stronger. Normal, Strong, Mighty… Pretty soon, he will...

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: モンスターからアップグレード

186002.description:
It's been three years since that incident when bullying pushed a lone girl over the edge. One day, however, someone with the same name as one of those classmates is killed. When Emiko hears the news about the death of the person who shared her name, she becomes uneasy and on edge. Emiko recalls that before her death, the victim told her, "You will be the sixth one I shall curse!" Has her turn finally come?!

A spine-chilling collection of psycho horror stories!

title.native: 誰かが殺しにやってくる
title.romaji: Dareka ga Koroshi ni Yatte Kuru

title.native: ファム・ファタールを召し上がれ
伽藍堂のガラクタたち

186006.description:
An ugly, inferior maid during the day and a real stunner at night. When Aisha's secret is out, the ill-wishers are genuinely surprised that Drew's intense feelings for her remain unchanged. A story about two people who get caught up in a tangled web of love.

(Source Webcomics)
synonyms: She Becomes Billionaire CEO's Substitute Wife
身代わり結婚からはじまる恋

title.native: 千亿总裁独宠替身娇妻
title.romaji: Qian Yi Zongcai Du Chong Tishen Jiaoqi

186008.description:
The vivid memory of a strong slap, when I was smacked down by a mysterious girl. Carrying the pain of my broken heart, I joined the “Slap-Fighting World Championship”! Can I overcome the pain of that episode and find the will to win?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

186009.description:
It's been a year since the founding of the Qin Dynasty, the first to unify the world in the 2nd Century BC. On that night of thunder, rumors spread that something terrible will happen, and a slave boy named Ray decides to escape with a mute infant. Without realizing the power that resides in his own body…

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 死霊術師ウェルツの平和論

186012.description:
Welcome to the World of "Ave Mujica"――. This is the official comic adaptation of TV anime "BanG Dream! Ave Mujica".
“Will you give me the rest of your life?”

(Source: Comic Growl)

Note: Chapter count reflects the original serialization. The chapters were later combined into 17 chapters for the tankōbon release.

186013.description:
The first collection of short stories by Kei Ookubo! This book contains five stories packed with charm.

1. The Dragon's Bride (竜の国の花嫁): A story about a lady officer's marriage that transcends race.
2. HAMMER HAMMER (ハンマー・ハンマー): Depicts the bond between dragon-man siblings.
3. JOSTE A knight who bravely fights to repay her father's debts.
4. Artillery Expert Faust (大砲屋のファウスト): A young man who goes to war for the sake of his beloved.
5. The Girl in the Workshop (工房の乙女): The work that became the inspiration for Arte.
synonyms: The Collected Short Stories of Kei Ohkubo

186014.description:
1. Shuugaku Ryokou Satsujin Jiken (修学旅行殺人事件)
2. Gakuensai Satsujin Jiken (学園祭殺人事件)

186015.description:
In June 2000, four young actors were working along with one big-name actress on the set of a drama. These still-new actors each different backgrounds, looks, and abilities, but who will be the one who makes it big? The story spans more than a quarter of a century, from 2000 to the present.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

186016.description:
Anzu is a girl who longs for a prince on a white horse. One day, she finds a mysterious book in the school library. When she opens it, the characters from Grimm's fairy tales sealed inside the book are released...!? And so begins a dark and emo fairy tale x school fantasy woven by a yandere Little Red Riding Hood boy and a bookish dreamer girl...

(Source: Mag Kan, translated)

title.english: The Obsession of Red Riding Hood

186017.description:
After being returned to the past multiple times, Lyatte finally succeeds in escaping execution by murdering her treasonous husband. The only catch is that each time she returned, it cost her half of her remaining lifespan, and now she has less than two years left. Determined to live the rest of her short life to its fullest, Lyatte decides to hold a contest to find a new husband. Will the competition be a success, or will Lyatte's time run out before she can experience true love?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I'm Looking for a New Husband

186018.description:
Hiding her identity as a Snow Maiden demon, Seol-Ha has carved out a life in disguise among humans. However, her life changes forever when she catches the interest of the Northern Prince, a man known for hunting down and killing demons, and agrees to become his bride. Will these two be able to overcome their differences and live happily ever after?

(Source: WEBTOON)

186019.description:
Kill monsters, save your neighbors, and expand your domain, all from the comfort of your couch. When his city becomes infested with monsters, Jae-Hyeon discovers an ability that makes him the absolute master of his apartment building. But his ability comes with a catch -- he cannot leave his apartment. Now, he must arm his neighbors and lead them beyond their building to survive the post-apocalyptic world they find themselves in.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: โทษที พื้นที่นี้ห้ามออก!

186020.description:
Ban Yuwon just wanted to get into college. But instead, he was summoned to an academy in another dimension. There, every student must climb the legendary Tower of Babel, built by Yuwon's own ancestor. Armed with the "Babylonian Code," an ability that lets him absorb and manipulate all languages, he sets out to conquer the tower and reclaim his family’s lost honor. However, with deadly monsters, hidden traps, and ruthless rivals from across dimensions, can Yuwon survive the climb?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Admission Is a Waste of Time

186021.description:
Killed for being an elementalist but brought back by the Spirit of Death, Azelda Madison is determined to survive her second chance at life. After relentless training, she meets her betrothed, Duke Shade Karloss, and fights by his side as a mercenary for five years while hiding her true identity. Unwilling to repeat the loveless marriage of her past, Azelda proposes a contract marriage with the duke. But as she gradually uncovers a hidden side to Shade, can she continue to abide by its terms?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Azelda: The Spirit Master's Contract Marriage

186022.description:
With her feisty temperament and unyielding attitude, Katherina Smirnoff is labeled a villainess by the men around her. Tired of the smug suitors trying to change her, she decides she'd rather not marry at all. While striving to escape their pursuit and stand up for herself, Katherina crosses paths with Nikolai de Bassily, the feared Grand Duke of Blood. To her surprise, he seems drawn to her and understands her for who she is. Could this be a chance at true love for the free-spirited Katherina?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Don't Try To Tame a Wild Spirit

186023.description:
After being cast out as a child over suspicions of illegitimacy, Perrianne was adopted by the queen of the neighboring kingdom and has been her loyal spy ever since. She's very happy with her new life when she suddenly hears perplexing news: Duke Exer's long-lost daughter has finally returned... except that's supposed to be her! Tasked with unmasking the imposter posing as herself, she's determined to just get the job done and get out of there. But will her family let her go so easily this time?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Saved You, but I'm Not Responsible
I May Have Saved You, but I Take No Responsibility For It
偶然助けただけなので、責任は取りません

title.english: The Duke's Family Is Not My Problem

186024.description:
After a tragic accident resulting in her death, Ms. Yeo is transported to the Cleaf Empire... for the second time! With her new identity as Yureia Cratia, she sets out to reclaim the guild she had built from the bottom up and uncover who was behind her previous murder. However, while hiding her true identity and searching for answers, she only comes up with more questions. Will she be able to find her killer before they discover that she has returned, or is she doomed to face death once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: There Is No Need to Be Obsessed

186025.description:
Hui-Ran used to be the disgrace of House Namgung, shunned by all, including her siblings. But after political intrigue destroys her family, Hui-Ran dies trying to avenge them. All seems lost until she reawakens in the past... as an adorable baby! But how can she help anyone in a baby’s body? And why are her siblings being so nice to her? Time has been reset—using her knowledge of the future, Hui-Ran must rewrite history and thwart the sinister dissidents who seek Namgung’s downfall.

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: Youngest Daughter of the Ultimate Martial Master Namgung Family
I Am the Youngest Daughter of Murim's Strongest, the Namgung Clan

title.english: Youngest Daughter of the Ultimate Martial Master Namgung Family

186026.description:
Tareya DeLov awakens in a novel to find herself married to the cold and aloof Duke Anteros Mel DeLov, who's cheating on her with a mistress! Appalled, she immediately petitions for divorce, hoping to keep her share of wealth and win the public's sympathy. But as the divorce comes closer to being approved, Anteros won't leave Tareya alone, remorseful and relentlessly begging her to reconsider. Will Tareya succeed in separating from her husband? And what's with Anteros' sudden shift in attitude?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Darling, Why Do You Regret It?

186027.description:
Luciel, a Crystal Fairy skilled in crafting jewels from her emotions, returns to the past after a life cut short by betrayal. Armed with the knowledge of a grim future, she proposes a contract marriage to the empire’s most villainous family. What begins as a desperate strategy to escape her fate soon becomes an adventure filled with unexpected warmth. Can Luciel rewrite her story, or will her past come back to haunt her?

(Source: TappyToon)

186028.description:
Thanks to having to juggle multiple part-time jobs, gloomy student Yura Itokura is on the verge of repeating a year. Kairi Seto, the very class president he detests, becomes his tutor, and he is forced to reluctantly invite him into his home. However, when Kairi's hand unexpectedly brushes against his ear, Yura lets out a sound that he never thought he could make. His body trembles from the pleasure of Kairi's relentless caressing, and though he wants to resist it, he can't help but melt into his touch...?

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Don't Let Me Indulge in Love With You

title.native: 溺れる熱にふれないで

186029.description:
After all the battles have supposedly concluded, there is one more unknown battle that will take place!

(Source: Shonen Sunday, translated)

title.native: うえきの法則エキシビション

186030.description:
From the day Yuri Shimanaka met Saki for the first time, the curtain was drawn on a dramatic story of revenge against the Okawa family that controlled the Honjin Town!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Note: Volume also includes the one-shot Saburou to Akushu! (三郎とあくしゅ！)

186031.description:
A festival that leads to a strange world. Eerie events lurking in everyday life. A story of the monster closest to you right now. A shadow that has its own will... The first collection packed full of strange tales drawn by the exceptional Morohoshi Daijiro. You will surely something miraculous that you have not seen yet.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 諸星大二郎劇場 第1集 雨の日はお化けがいるから
title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijiro Gekijou: Dai 1-Shuu - Ame no Hi wa Obake ga Iru Kara

title.native: 諸星大二郎劇場 第2集 オリオンラジオの夜
title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijiro Gekijou: Dai 2-shuu - Orion Radio no Yoru

title.native: 諸星大二郎劇場 第3集 美少女を食べる
title.romaji: Moroboshi Daijiro Gekijou: Dai 3-shuu - Bishoujo wo Taberu

title.native: 諸星大二郎劇場 第4集 アリスとシェエラザード
title.romaji: Moroboshi Daijiro Gekijou: Dai 4-shuu - Alice to Scheherazade

title.native: 諸星大二郎劇場 第5集 アリスとシェエラザード～仮面舞踏会～
title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijiro Gekijou: Dai 5-shuu - Alice and Scheherazade ~Kamen Butoukai~

186036.description:
"My son Mamoru is called "Amo-kun" by his younger cousins. Mamoru and I went camping but couldn't get into it, so we went for a walk in the forest. After dark, I returned to the campsite with a tired Mamoru on my back to find..."

This story depicts the other world that lurks in the everyday life of this family!
(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

186037.description:
Ayane is blackmailed by a corrupt teacher when he finds out about her illicit sexual relationship. Now her lips, her big tits, and her entire body, which she had wanted to devote to Nobuya alone, are being toyed with by another man, and the pleasure is seared into her body! She is penetrated by something more powerful than what Nobuya could give her, and it's pouring sperm into her womb! Even other teachers and school mates join in…

(Source: Bishoujo Bunko, translated)

186038.description:
Nicknamed "Belle Poupee"--the Beautiful Doll--duke's daughter Lady Leticia is admired for her elegance and delicate beauty. But behind her porcelain mask lies her true self: a bold and compassionate soul, more knight than damsel. She ends up engaged to the infamous second prince, Gilbert, whose cursed crimson eyes and icy demeanor have made him the subject of troubling rumors. Fate binds together an infallible Princess Charming and a lonely, awkward prince as they search for their happily ever after in this ultimate role-reversal love story.

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: Ma Belle Poupée est un Super Darling

title.native: ベル・プペーのスパダリ婚約～「好みじゃない」と言われた人形姫、我慢をやめたら皇子がデレデレになった。実に愛い！
title.romaji: Belle Poupée no Supadari Konyaku: "Konomi ja Nai" to Iwareta Ningyou Hime, Gaman wo Yametara Ouji ga Deredere ni Natta. Jitsu ni Ui!

186039.description:
The Duchess Laetitia is nicknamed “Belle Poupée,” the beautiful doll. Despite her fragile appearance, she is actually a dashing heroine who charms both men and women alike! With a magical artifact, she can transform herself into the powerful warrior known as the “Imperious Ice Dragon,” but her true identity is known only to a few people. She is engaged to Gilbert, “The Cursed Prince,” who is rumored to have a wicked personality. Gilbert has always treated her coldly since they first met, but when she got to know his loneliness and clumsy kindness, Letitia's heart is touched…

"I will make you happy, Master."

The turbulent newlywed life between the strongest heroine and her love-struck husband begins now!

(Source: Square Enix Novels, translated)

title.native: ベル・プペーのスパダリ婚約～「好みじゃない」と言われた人形姫、我慢をやめたら皇子がデレデレになった。実に愛い！
title.romaji: Belle Poupée no Supadari Konyaku: "Konomi ja Nai" to Iwareta Ningyou Hime, Gaman wo Yametara Ouji ga Deredere ni Natta. Jitsu ni Ui!

186040.description:
Clarisse, second daughter of Viscount Fahrenheit, was treated cruelly by her family. When she became nineteen, her father arranged a marriage for her...to marry Margrave Gutenberg, who asked the King for the "Jewel of Fahrenheit" as his bride, as a reward to his victories in the war. But the "Jewel" was her sister, Matilda. Clarisse was a substitute bride. Clarisse was almost happy that she could get out of her miserable life at home, but also afraid that the margrave would know she was a substitute. It was a surprise when she found out that he was rather a thoughtful and handsome man. She started to enjoy spending days with him, and it seemed like he feels the same way. Then came the day that her family secret was revealed...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: Migawarino Hanayome ha, Bukiyou na Henkyouhaku ni Dekiai Sareru
Why Claris was Married to Jean

title.native: 身代わりの花嫁は、不器用な辺境伯に溺愛される
title.romaji: Migawari no Hanayome wa, Bukiyou na Henkyou Haku ni Dekiaisareru

186041.description:
Clarisse, a viscountess living in the royal capital, has always been compared to her beautiful elder sister, who is known as “the jewel of Farenheit.” She is forced to lived in the shadows, pressured by her family to keep a low profile. When Clarisse is nineteen, she marries Siegfried Gutenberg, the “man-eating frontierman,” as a reward for his success in war, in place of her sister. It turns out that the frontier count is a stoic, but caring and surprisingly charming man who treated Clarice kindly. Clarisse, however, feels guilty about being a “substitute bride,” and is afraid to entrust her heart to him. Then news of her sister's wedding arrives from the capital, and they decide to visit the capital for the occasion. But Clarisse's family hides a big secret, and the circumstances of her marriage are very different from what she expected! In this royal love fantasy, an unfortunate lady finds happiness with the love of her life on the remote frontier!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 身代わりの花嫁は、不器用な辺境伯に溺愛される
title.romaji: Migawari no Hanayome wa, Bukiyou na Henkyou Haku ni Dekiaisareru

186042.description:
1. Koukan Nikki Satsujin Jiken (交換日記殺人事件)
2. Kagai Jugyou Satsujin Jiken (課外授業殺人事件)

186044.description:
My boyfriend Hiroki is popular with both men and women, so he's what people would call an "extrovert." He goes out drinking and snowboarding in big groups with other girls… I can't help but get jealous about this, so we used to fight about it quite often.

I wanted him to be the one who gets jealous sometimes, so I told him that one of my classmates had confessed to me.

He was like, "Oh, yeah?"

The next day, he acted casually on our regular date at a manga cafe. In my head I was like, "What, that's all?? So he doesn't like me anymore??" But Hiroki noticed when I got a text from the classmate who confessed to me.

"Is it really that important? That guy's text…"
"You told me he confessed to you, but you were the one who led him on, weren't you?"

And so, the jealous-fucking with my usually laid-back boyfriend began…

(Source: DLSite, translated)
synonyms: 總是泰然自若的陽角男友的嫉妒性愛停不下來！！

title.english: My Usually Laid-back Boyfriend Can’t Stop Having Jealous Sex with Me!!
title.native: いつも余裕な陽キャ彼氏の嫉妬えっちが止まらない!!
title.romaji: Itsumo Yoyuna Youkya Kareshi no Shitto Ecchi ga Tomaranai!!

186045.description:
A grotesque, horrifying, mysterious incident befalls 12-year-old Yumi. At Yumi's birthday party, which she invites classmates to, her mischievous older sister Mari puts a toy toad's leg in the food. Sayuri, who has an abnormal hatred for frogs, ends up eating it. However, when she spat it out, the frog's leg was still slithering about as if it was alive. Sayuri stayed home from school after that, but terrifying changes began to occur to her body...

(Source: K-Manga)

title.romaji: Watashi no Hada ni Noroi no Kao ga

186046.description:
Ruin Demedium is a student at the Royal Academy of the kingdom of Hillsland, where the future elite of the country are schooled. Unfortunately for Ruin, he is not the best in his class and is regarded by his fellow students and teachers as worthless. In a move to get rid of him, Ruin is assigned to the backwater town of Boinbara, a town plagued by bandits and run by a corrupt lord, where it’s expected he’ll either be stuck there forever or die. However, Ruin’s surprising success in dealing with the problems of the town will draw him into a struggle for the future of the kingdom as the king is about to choose a successor to the throne.

(Source: Bookwormotaku)

186051.description:
The long-awaited collection of 16 short stories by Daijiro Morohoshi, the trailblazing creator of otherworldly stories, is now available! It includes his fantastic debut one-shot, Junko Kyoukatsu.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 諸星大二郎短編集 彼方へ

synonyms: By the window of Cafe Lily

title.native: カフェーリリーの窓辺にて

186054.description:
As the daughter of a bankrupt Count, Leila's fate hinges on repaying the loan her father took from the businessman Maximilian Volkov. Missing even one payment could force Leila into marrying him as compensation. With the repayment date approaching and little hope of meeting the deadline, Leila is unexpectedly saved by her first love, a wealthy Colonel named Silvester, who proposes marriage. Although Leila has always dreamed of marrying for love, Silvester insists theirs will be a marriage of convenience and refuses to consummate it. Despite her belief that divorce is imminent, their arrangement continues for three years. Then, one day, Silvester is attacked and loses his memory. Strangely, he begins treating Leila with utmost tenderness, showering her with affection. In a surprising turn of events, their relationship shifts from the brink of divorce to a loving, affectionate marriage with just one incident.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: Mon faux mari ne veut plus divorcer

title.native: 離婚寸前!?なのにコワモテ夫は溺愛夫になりました
title.romaji: Rikon Sunzen!? Nanoni Kowamote Otto wa Dekiai Otto ni Narimashita

186055.description:
Leila, a down-on-her-luck noblewoman, gets a helping hand from her first love, Silvester, a wealthy soldier, by entering into a contract marriage. They have been a couple for three years now, without having even having consummated the marriage. Leila expects her husband to divorce her at any time, but he is attacked by an assailant and loses his memory of their arrangement due to his injuries.

"My wife is so beautiful,” he says, "It makes me want you so much.”

Having lost his memory, Silvester begins to dote on Leila with sweet, seductive words.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title.native: 離婚寸前!? 仮面夫婦からの溺愛生活 コワモテ軍人は奥様に夢中です
title.romaji: Rikon Sunzen!? Kamen Fuufu Kara no Dekiai Seikatsu: Kowamote Gunjin wa Oku-sama ni Muchuu desu

186056.description:
Prince Flynn of Albion is adored for his charm and good looks-but the endless dating rumors? Not so much. Tired of the gossip, he proposes a bold idea to his secretary, Drew: pretend to date him to control the narrative. It’s all for show…until Drew starts seeing Flynn in a different light. Can a staged romance turn into something real?

(Source: Lezhin US)

186059.description: A dream bird enters the depths of your heart and shows you your dream. Yet, what if you cannot accept what you see?

186060.description: A boy wondered how to build his castle.

186062.description: While watching a TV show with her husband, Shouko's world was turning upside down because of her husband's words, "After all, married couples are just strangers."

186063.description:
Overwhelmed by the endless affection of her overly clingy boyfriend Se-in, Roha finally decides to call it quits. But when Se-in keeps acting like nothing ever happened, she starts to wonder…are they really broken up, or still together somehow? In the middle of her confusion, Yeonjun suddenly moves in as a boarder - young, hot and secretly in love with Roha for the past ten years. Between an ex who won’t let go and a long-time admirer living under her roof, Roha’s love life is about to spiral completely out of control. It really wasn't supposed to be like this...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.
synonyms: รักแบบพอดีน่ะมีมั้ย?!

title.english: It Wasn’t Supposed to Be Like This

186064.description:
Soyo, a demon fox, sneaks into the palace to steals a man’s affection. While searching for the world’s best Yang energy, she meets prince Ahan. Soyo tries to seduce him, but her true identity is discovered, and instead, she becomes aroused by his touch…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: The Fox who Stole my Heart

186065.description:
Abandoned by her parents and friends, Choi Yeon is a struggling college student determined to escape poverty. To conceal her circumstances, she takes a job as an in-house tutor for Ji Shinwoo, the reserved youngest son of a wealthy family. There, she meets his older brother, Ji Sinhyeok, the arrogant and possessive eldest son of the house. Before long, Sinhyeok ropes Yeon into running odd errands for him, pulling her into his world. Despite his cold and crude remarks and domineering attitude, Yeon finds herself drawn to him, torn between frustration and the hope that he might desire her too.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: แด่สิ่งที่แตกสลาย

title.native: 美しビルの解かない探偵

186067.description:
Chae Rin has an unspeakable secret. She loves to roleplay getting sexually harrased. [Post] Pervert roleplayer wanted. That’s how she met the stranger.

“Look in front of you. Do you want to get caught?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: 痴漢フェチ〜人には言えない私の性癖〜

186068.description: Note: Also includes the one-shot Dream Dome (ドリーム・ドーム)

title.native: 悪魔たちのパラダイス

186069.description:
"Give me back my daughter!" Haruko's newborn daughter is taken from her after a decision made at a family meeting she wasn't included in. On top of that, she must deal with an emotionally abusive mother-in-law, a sister-in-law with a horrid personality, and a passive husband. Unsurprisingly, her lonely struggle and sorrowful marriage life begin to take a toll on her... Grab your handkerchief! This new tale spun by Minami Q-ta is sure to bring on the waterworks!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

186070.description:
1. Poseidon no Shima (海神の島)
2. Mukashi Sora kara (むかし空から)
3. Hana wo Sagashite (花をさがして)

186071.description:
1. Fushigi na Mori no Mandragola (不思議な森のマンドラゴラ)
2. Hitoyobitani Densetsu (人呼谷伝説)

title.native: ふしぎな森のマンドラゴラ

186072.description:
1. Yomi no Kotori (黄泉の小鳥)
2. Kaze no Lullaby (風のララバイ)

Just because he’s physically big, he’s expected to act like a tough guy… Ooda Jun is an office worker who’s fed up with living up to other people’s expectations of him. On his way home from work one day, he stops by an outdoor store where he meets a cheerful clerk named Itsuki Takeru. Unable to resist the sales talk, Jun goes camping for the first time with the man! Jin-Tae Seo and his younger sister Ji-Na, a purple-eyed albino, are separated after being kidnapped by human traffickers. After two years of torment, Jin-Tae is rescued by an assassin named Shin Kim. After years of training, Jin-Tae, now an assassin himself, follows a lead to Hong Kong to find his sister. After accidentally getting involved in a gang war, it is revealed that Ji-Na is apparently an assassin working for Kai Liu, another albino, who is rebelling against the Triad, and claims that Ji-Na is his half-sister. In a world where humans and monsters are indistinguishable, the “True Raider” emerges! After the appearance of monsters that tear humans apart, society has divided into two parts, “Raiders” and “Non-Raiders”. 24-year-old Lee Se-Min, unable to become a Raider no matter how hard he tries, confines himself to a small room. One day, he stumbles upon a strange website. ｢ Welcome, new member. To Transcendental Network. A community connecting transcendent beings across dimensions.｣ They reveal to him the true world of martial prowess. Amidst the chaos where humans and monsters are indistinguishable, the “True Raider” is about to make their entrance!

“Bring it on, you bastards.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

186080.description:
Seol Dan-A, an ordinary high school girl who fantasizes about being successful, is struggling to fit in with a group of kids after accidentally becoming friends with them. Then, Dan-A's 'first love', who has changed so much on the outside and inside that she is completely unrecognizable, transfers to the school, and the first love, who is trapped in memories of Seol Dan-A in the past, becomes creepily obsessed with Dan-A. "Dudae-a-dae-a, I'll give you an old house, so come and buy me a new one"

The children try to make this house their hideout, but end up getting trapped in it... Will the children be able to get out of this house safely? What on earth happened in this house?

Her stepsister once doused her in boiling water, leaving a scar that resulted in Ines being called "ugly" by her abusive new husband. To make matters worse, Ines' husband begins an affair with her stepsister. That is when Ines is approached by a handsome nobleman known as the "Cold-Blooded Marquess", who proposes marriage. "Let's get married tomorrow."

Emma is an ordinary girl who dreams of a normal marriage and happiness, working as a maid in the castle. Except that she has memories of her previous life…

After tending to a badly injured knight… Ralph, the widely admired knight-commander, takes a liking to her. But Emma was traumatized by knights in her previous life, and she doesn't ever want anything to do with the “Knight Commander”! But then she is assigned to be the maid for his knight squadron, He even asks her to marry him…!

She tries to refuse by telling him that they hardly even know each other.
But he asks her, "That just means we'll have to get to know each other better, right?"

In order to overcome his weakness, he enrolls in Some-no-e University, a rural college that is 90% female, and ends up living in a former women's dormitory where there are only two men, including himself. Ren is nervous and anxious about his new life. And on his first day at the new school, he is propositioned for sex by a cool college girl, Beni, who is his senior! Ren can't help but wonder if his rosy harem life is about to begin!!!! He thought he had a chance… but things change suddenly. The body of a woman is found dead on university grounds. Moreover, there is something creepy about the university's alien atmosphere and the way the girls look at him. Is it just a school, or is there something else…!

Can he resist the temptations of these dangerous women in a university with a 90% female population! If he gives in, something bad might happen, in a school thriller of pleasure and fear!!!!

On Yu-I, a boy who is falsely accused of stalking a female student in the same class, becomes an outcast. A beautiful transfer student named Yu Mi-So visits his hellish daily life. The one-eyed prince, Shion, is forced to flee his homeland after his brother's betrayal. To escape his pursuers, he sets out for the country of his late mother's birth. Accompanying him on this perilous journey is his loyal knight and childhood protector, Fey. But upon reaching a safe haven, Fey is suddenly removed from Shion's personal service and begins to act suspiciously.
"I will protect you with my life, Your Highness," he had vowed from the day they met, and Fey has always upheld that promise. Now, however, as Fey reveals an unexpected side of himself, Shion finds himself unsettled and unsure of what lies beneath the knight’s steadfast loyalty…

A gentle hand around his waist, sweet lips pressed upon his own, and a deep connection forged in the unknowable past: Sylhan is confused, but unable to stop himself from being drawn ever closer to the mysterious man. Unable to save the child, Dr. Han Jaeyoung was left with no choice but to watch him return to a life of torment.
But when Jaeyoung stabs Ikjoong to death, he feels no remorse.
With the help of his mentor, Dr. Choi Taekyung, Jaeyoung escapes conviction under a plea of self-defense. Resigned to leaving his medical career behind, his plans change when the charismatic CEO Jae Woojin offers him a position at Seonggyeol Hospital.

"If you come work for me, those kinds of people won't be able to harm you so easily because I take care of my people."

Though reluctant at first, Jaeyoung finds himself drawn to Woojin’s relentless persuasion. Finally succumbing, he steps into Seonggyeol Hospital—a decision that will entangle him in a web of temptation, power, and justice.

186248.description: On Christmas Eve night, Meiko, a female college student, planned to spend a peaceful evening alone on the island. However, when she woke up, a corpse was lying in front of her. From that moment, she was faced with a series of grueling trials unlike anything she had ever experienced before. To reunite with her parents, whom she parted with in an unfortunate way, she must survive—even in this twisted world.

186249.description:
After years of being cooped up at home, Ah-Yeong finally lands a job as a café manager—thanks to a friend—and moves into her first apartment. Wanting to be a friendly neighbor, she brings cookies to the guy next door… only to discover he’s none other than Wujin, the student she used to tutor ten years ago! What starts as a casual reunion soon turns into regular dinners and cozy evenings together. But one night, while Ah-Yeong is distracted prepping dinner, Wujin accidentally knocks over a box—and out rolls a very intimate gift from her friend: a dildo. Mortified, Ah-Yeong scrambles to hide it, but Wujin just smiles and says,

“As your former student, I feel it’s only right I help out.”

Excuse me?! When did this shy little student grow up—and how did this become that kind of tutoring? This definitely wasn’t in the lesson plan…

(Source: Lezhin US)

186250.description:
Yui is good at housework but she's not a big fan of cats. Working as a housekeeper to help support her family, her new client is a man named Yoru Shinonome. He is an artist and illustrator, and with his jet-black hair and beautiful dark eyes, he is like a “black cat” personified! Yui finds his cat-like behavior and attitude difficult to deal with at first, but he respects her work ethic, and for some reason, she feels attracted to him…?

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.romaji: Shikkoku no Neko wa Dekiai Suru

186251.description: The protagonist, Fujiyoshi Mizuki, is a high school girl who lives on the north side of Hanamikoji in Gion, Kyoto. Gion Hanamikoji is a well-known tourist spot, but the north side is an entertainment district filled with host clubs and cabaret clubs. Mizuki is familiar with Hikaru, the hired manager of Club Paradiso, and is a member of the Japanese Culture Club at school. He asks her to read "The Tale of Genji" for him. However, Mizuki, who is not usually very emotional, does not understand the emotion of "sorrow" written in "The Tale of Genji"...

186253.description: Note: A compilation doujin for this series, titled "Ienai Koto Bakari Soushuuhen" was published on Dec 31, 2025 at C107.

186256.description:
Can I fall in love with you!?

Tax accountant Miki Usui is good at her job, rich, and beautiful - the perfect woman everyone envies! --Except for one weakness: she has no eye for men... Miki keeps getting dumped, as if her money is running out, and her junior colleague, Sachi, gives her lukewarm support. But has Miki met the man of her dreams...?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

The main character, So So-Hee, becomes pregnant at the age of 20, the most shining age. Her life begins to go awry due to the devastating situation of pregnancy.

“Can I be a good mother to you?”

(Source: Namu Wiki, translated)
synonyms: แค่ลูกคนเดียว

186263.description:
Whether in baseball, soccer, or academics, Kousei Akiyama was always an unrivaled prodigy. Determined to make his name known worldwide, the sixth-grader decides to pursue the game of Go. However, waiting for him at his local Go academy are five young geniuses who utterly crush his overwhelming talent.
Broken by this setback, Kousei settles into an ordinary life. Now a high school student, he encounters Go once again. With his dormant abilities finally blossoming, he swears revenge against the five prodigies who defeated him, ready to reclaim the absolute feeling of invincibility he once knew!

(Source: YanMaga Web, translated)

title.native: 悶絶 フタナリ学園

186266.description:
Seo Jung-Won, a scoop reporter who grabs bad guys by the collar. She had a perfect life with intelligence, beauty, and a third-generation chaebol husband. Until her husband's mistress turns up dead. It's shocking to know that her husband, who she thought was a single-mindedly affectionate man, had a mistress, but as she begins to be suspected of being the murderer who killed her, new incidents start to intertwine and entangle Jung-Won like a spider's web as she tries to escape. Jung-Won digs for the truth with her longtime partner Jesus and detective Tae-Heon, who becomes her new partner by accident, and faces unbelievable truths.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Oh, come on - let's grab each other by the collar

186267.description:
When Ha-Jun and Ha-Na returned to their hometown to live with their grandmother, a suspicious religion, Posinism, awaited them. The villagers' fanatical belief in Posinism gradually grew, reaching a point where it threatened Ha-Jun and Ha-Na's safety...

(Source: Naver, translated)

186275.description:
Reincarnated into... an otome game she’s never played?! Elna, an ordinary viscount's daughter, realizes at her academy entrance ceremony that she has been reincarnated into the world of the otome game "Rainbow Paradise." However, having never actually played the game, her only knowledge consists of the main characters' appearances and the impressions shared by a friend. Just as she resolves to live a quiet, inconspicuous life, she somehow finds herself getting entangled with the main male lead, a prince, and the beautiful heroine...?! A slow-burn fantasy romance begins between an ordinary, embroidery-loving noblewoman and a prince who is breathtakingly handsome but utterly oblivious!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.english: An Ordinary Noblewoman Reincarnated into an Unplayed Otome Game Stitches Sacred Embroidery Thread

186276.description:
As the best arcane swordsman, Hildegart's feats made House Acaraxia the greatest noble family in the empire, amassing both wealth and prestige. But after being tasked with sealing away the Demon God, Hildegart was forced to sacrifice her life. In a twist of fate, she wakes up in the body of her 12-year-old great-great-grandniece 80 years later, where, much to her shock, her family has fallen into total ruin. Can the reincarnation of the first Hildegart restore her family to its former glory?

(Source: Tapas)

186277.description:
Jeong-min, who accidentally tore up her classmates’ novel, suddenly found herself in the world of the torn novel after she woke up. For a bookworm like her, both her current situation and the new world she is in are completely incomprehensible.

Though she has no knowledge of the world she is in, her unique fiery personality will make up for it.

That’s why, no matter what obstacles come’s her way, she will give it her best!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The Ignorant Girl Becomes a Princess
I, Who Am Ignorant of This World, Became a Princess

186280.description:
A small, thin moan. The feel of skin against heated breath. Ragiha, a princess and a magician of great pedigree, took the controversial Wikkann, Zane, as her servant at the tender age of five, defying the disapproving stares of her court. She treated and cared for him like family. But one night, Ragiha dreams of doing unspeakable things with Zane. Relief washes over her when she wakes up, only to shatter when she realizes it wasn’t a dream at all. The man she once considered family has imprisoned her in a place of his own making. Ragiha must navigate her conflicting feelings for her friend-turned-lover while her fate—and that of her kingdom—hangs in the balance.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I, Yukino Nagase, am a high school girl who has erotic fantasies about Kurosawa-san, the (female) health teacher! Until now, I've only admired her from afar, but today, for the first time, I'm going to use a sudden illness as an excuse to get up close and personal with her!

186298.description:
Kanata, living and working in Tokyo, decides to return to Kyoto when he learns that a time capsule from 15 years ago will be opened in a ceremony at his old high school. He recalls “Akane Haruta,” who passed away during his senior year. For Kanata, who was involved in the Movie Club during his high school years, Akane Haruta was his muse and first love, until she suddenly committed suicide. It turns out that Akane had put in one of the Movie Club's home-made video tapes in the time capsule, and the friends who had made the film decide to watch it together. However, there was a shocking voice left on the tape along with behind-the-scenes footage of the film's production…‼ Was Akane's death really a suicide…? Kanata, Kanata's best friend Ninomura, the actress Kaori, and the rest of his former classmates are now on the hunt for the truth of Akane's death… Will they be able to find out what really happened⁉ A nostalgic mystery that begins with the pain of lost youth and reunions.

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

This is a story about two people preparing for the sports festival.

186301.description:
The study of folklore as an academic discipline was founded by Yanagida Kunio, a university scholar of the Showa period. However, there was another scholar, Hyodo Kitakami, who dared to investigate the heretical stories that had to be discarded in the process of making folklore into science!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

186303.description:
Toshina is a 27-year old woman who works for an advertising company. She throws herself into her work to distract herself from the loneliness and anxiety of being alone, after having lost all of her family. One day, a man in military uniform suddenly appears in front of Toshina in a flash of light. At first she is puzzled by Takeo, the mysterious young man who has time-slipped from the past to the present day, but she becomes sympathetic to his situation and gradually becomes attracted to him. Eventually, their feelings for each other are consummated, and they decide to live together in the present day. However, they are suddenly transported back in time, to the era in which Takeo lived.

(Source: Comic Donna, translated)

title.native: 軍人流求婚 ～100年物の純愛～

186304.description:
Humans grow and age. They change. But always we are the same person, the same creature. Not so with insects, whose powers of metamorphosis alter not only their shape and size, but also their very beings. And now, because of one young man's unhealthy obsession with bugs, humans also find themselves transformed into disgusting, decrepit, bloodsucking insect monsters!

(Source: Living the Line)

186311.description:
Jun-Won, a perfect man, and Ju-I, a woman who knows her abilities and charms, strike an unusual deal: they will date with one strict condition—no falling in love. What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes complicated as unexpected feelings begin to surface. Can they stick to their promise, or will emotions get the better of them? Dive into a world where love is both the goal and the enemy, and find out if their hearts will follow the rules or break free.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

186312.description:
Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

186314.description:
I wish I could have a normal romantic relationship.
Normal like picking up a gun from an ATM—
Wait, that's not normal at all!

Ah, love can be so bittersweet.
Like the bitter almond taste of cyanide…

(Source: Creative Comic Collection, translated)

186315.description:
"When you can't forget someone, don't you think alcohol and sex are the best remedies?"

Asuma met his soulmate in college, but for the past ten years, he's been heartbroken and unable to fall in love again. Now a doctor, his lingering feelings refuse to fade. After discovering that his soulmate has had a child, Asuma drowns his sorrows in alcohol. That's when Homare, a stranger resembling his soulmate, approaches him. Caught up in his heartbreak and drunkenness, they spend the night together. The next day, Asuma is shocked to run into Homare at the hospital cafe! Recently dumped by his alpha ex-boyfriend, Homare is heartbroken himself. He suddenly asks Asuma, "Why don't we become friends with benefits?" As they seek comfort in each other, can their relationship evolve into something deeper, or are they destined to remain each other's emotional bandages?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ロマンチック・エレジー

186316.description:
Sato is an office worker who has feelings for his colleague of the same sex, Kimura.
Even though he is married with a wife, Kimura keeps sleeping with Sato.
But then Yamaguchi, a co-worker, finds out about their illicit relationship.
Meanwhile, Kimura's wife grows paranoid about her husband's lack of passion.
Everyone is hiding the truth from each other.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Notes:
- Chapter 1 was previously released as a one-shot under the title "go-to" in the Yomikiri Anthology "Choushoku, Shimashou ka."
- Includes two extra chapters.

186317.description:
There are only two girls in this class that was formerly a boys school.
For some reason, these two gals seem to like Maibara-kun a lot.
And this is making the other 35 boys in the class mighty jealous of Maibara-kun…?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

186318.description:
Saori is a lingerie designer, but she is neither particularly sexy nor good with men. The president of her company tells her to get some romantic experience, for the sake of better design, but she is too stubborn and timid to take the plunge… Then one day, she meets Sekiya, a rude but handsome man at a bar. When they share a cab ride home, he kisses her out of the blue. Then at the urging of her junior colleague, Saori ends up going on a date with him. Saori's calm mask is on the verge of cracking at his aggressive approach…!

(Source: Berry's Books, translated)

186319.description:
Shizuku has no interest in romance, as her work and hobbies are enough to make her life fulfilling. Her mother wants her to marry, though, and at her insistence, Shizuku concedes to meeting Takaharu, a handsome and elite researcher, just to see if they might be a good match. Then, at their very first meeting, Takaharu pops the question out of nowhere...! He also gives a very well-reasoned pitch on how the arrangement would benefit them both, which Shizuku finds so persuasive that she accepts his proposal on the spot.

Despite starting on such a mercenary note, their newlywed life sees Shizuku developing deeper feelings for the calm and gentle Takaharu. At the same time, though, the way he always maintains a polite distance and never even tries to touch her leaves Shizuku full of doubt...!!

Meanwhile, Takaharu is closely guarding certain hidden feelings of his own... Letting the right moment for a wedding night slip past them was just the start of the hectic, heart-pounding romance for this adorably unfortunate fledgling couple.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: 對相親結婚來說初夜是必要的嗎？

186320.description:
Shizuku, who has never been in a relationship before, is arranged to marry Takaharu, a handsome and elite business analyst. However, their life together is nothing like a newlywed couple. Shizuku is concerned about her husband's cool and impassive personality, but one day, when another man makes a pass at her, Takaharu embraces her possessively! He unexpectedly kisses her, telling her sweetly "I don't want you to look at any another man," and it sets Shizuku heart fluttering…?

(Source: Berry's Bunko, translated)

"You don't have to force yourself to love me, okay?"

Akito Isshiki is a high-spec man with good looks and a fun personality. Rika Noguchi is a girl who is single-minded devoted to her work and averse to romance. They get married out of mutual convenience. In other words, they are not romantically involved! But for some reason, he treats her like a doting lover!

(Source: Ohzora Shuppan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a bonus chapter and the one-shot "Kouhai-kun no ×× wo Sawatte Shimaimashitatsu!"

Yuta's been keeping a secret from his mother. He's in love with her—horny thoughts included. But after she discovers his secret, she still accepts him for how he is. A mother's love knows no bounds, but what lines will be crossed?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (URE-090) was released on April 7th, 2023.

186330.description:
Our protagonist has a serious problem with a common game trope—he loves the mom characters, but they always die! Even when he tries every route to save them, his beloved heroines only exist to lose their lives and advance the story. But when he’s reincarnated as the villainous noble in a game he already beat, he decides to use his experience and unrivaled talent to make every mom character happy. Can he overturn fate and save the characters he loves, or is he doomed to play out his nightmare all over again?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

186331.description:
Angelica, the ancestral "Vampire Princess of the Fallen Kingdom," as she is known, will destroy a kingdom with her magic today. The reason why—

"Ma… ma…"

It's all for the sake of her too-cute daughter!

When Angelica found a human baby abandoned in the forest, she brought her home. She was immediately fascinated by the baby's soft, plump skin and her pure, undefiled heart, and a ruthless killer became a loving mother. But one day, the King foolishly tries to kidnap Angelica daughter, whom she named Pearl, because of her special power as a "saint." Naturally, Angelica is furious!

The word "mercy" no longer exists in her vocabulary, as “Mama” will use any means at her disposal to destroy her enemies!

A powerful vampire princess will go on a rampage out of love!
A dark fantasy about a doting mother!

(Source: Corona Comics)

Notes:

When Angelica found a human baby abandoned in the forest, she brought her home. She was immediately fascinated by the baby's soft, plump skin and her pure, undefiled heart, and a ruthless killer became a loving mother. But one day, the King foolishly tries to kidnap Angelica daughter, whom she named Pearl, because of her special power as a "saint." Naturally, Angelica is furious!

186334.description:
Ai runs into her ex-boyfriend Yosuke for the first time in six months, after he gave up on his dream of becoming a comedian and left her, just as he was about to turn 30. Ai can feel the influence of another woman in his fitted business suit and new glasses, and Ai secretly curses at that woman. He felt like living with her as a failed comedian was an embarrassment. But the longer they are apart, the more her feelings seem to grow…? Will they be able to overcome their misunderstandings to patch things up and get back together?

(Source: Muteki Renai S*Girl)

186335.description:
The Gokumon clan - a bloodline from hell. Living in their mysterious stronghold in the ancient capital of Kyoto, they command fear not only from those who wield magic, but also monsters and demons. Nadeshiko Gokumon is the monster-devouring heiress of this wicked family. She is the most beautiful, and the most abominable, girl who comes straight from the flames of hell.

However......
"Nadeshiko, I see you are as lovely as your name."
The encounter with the most strange, disturbing, and beautiful woman, Amana Ichijiku, who laughs in her face without fear, changes Nadeshiko.

Something lurks in the flower ceiling. A human sacrifice packed in a box. A curse that threaten the school. A deceitful beast. A shapeless monster. As the two confront one supernatural challenge after another, they eventually come face to face with the very thing they have been turning away from.

"If it weren't for you, I would still be an ogre."

A woman with a human soul in an ogre's body and a girl with a monstrous soul in a human body. The connection between the two is a story that will be sealed with blood.

(Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)

186339.description: The start of something between a boy and a girl.

186345.description:
"Yes! Yes! I finally bit one!"

Luluna Von Bettelheim, four-hundred-year-old vampire of noble lineage, wakes from her long slumber, and on a whim, enrolls in a human school. There she bites a girl and gains a servant. "Shower me with praise!" she orders. But her command leads to even more affection an she expected. Teren Mikami (prose) and Minori Chigusa (manga) team up to bring you a sensual girls' comedy about a vampire and her cute, high-school servant Wakana.

(Source: One Peace Books)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and note, was then licensed by Akita Shoten for serialization.

title.native: ガールズ×ヴァンパイア

186348.description:
Welcome, if you please, to a soul-stirring sneak peek into the lives of all kinds of anthropomorphic figures. From beastmen to gods, androids, and more, this luxurious anthology features works from many—including Ryoko Kui (Delicious in Dungeon), Suzuka Morino (Servant Beasts), and Hachi Inaba (The Tiger Won’t Eat the Dragon Yet)!

(Source: Yen Press)

186351.description: A collection of Shirayama's first manga.

Ai da to ka Fukushuu da to ka

186356.description:
Middle school brawler Noboru Haitani has never lost a fight. But the bitter taste of a soccer defeat gradually warms him up to the sport, until one day Haitani finds himself in a match against a team featuring middle school soccer prodigy Takami. An outlaw fights his way into the world of soccer!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186361.description: Pokémon Battle Stories is about the struggles of a girl named Wakaba, a reporter in charge of creating a book about Pokémon. She travels to various places to interview trainers.

title.native: ポケモンバトルストーリーズ

186362.description:
The triplets of a predetermined fate.

"I am the doppelganger of a murderer."
br> (Source: Namu, translated)

186363.description:
Yun, the best concubine of Joseon, is ordered by the king to investigate the five concubines who did not submit their virginity certificates to the selection order. He makes a contract with Seo Kyung, the most talented of the concubines who sells goods to the concubines, to find the one who will become the queen, and they pretend to be a married couple and begin their journey to find the queen...

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Selection of Queens in Joseon Dynasty
À la Recherche de la nouvelle Reine

title.native: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうか　オラリオ・ストーリーズ
title.romaji: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka: Orario Storys

186365.description:
The city of Orario is a vast metropolis with an underground labyrinth known as the Dungeon. There, adventurers put everything on the line to keep the monsters at bay and explore the unknown! This is where heroes are made and legends are born. Smaller stories can also be found here, and a surprising number of them revolve around a young boy who came to the Labyrinth City chasing his dreams until he met a certain goddess...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Minor Myths and Legends

186366.description:
Although their lives were saved, Saori, Seiya, and the others have lost their memories. What will happen to them?

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

2. Saint Seiya: THEN II - Shimei (聖闘士星矢 THEN II 便命); Monthly Champion RED 2026-02
3. Saint Seiya: THEN III - Ketsui (聖闘士星矢 THEN III 決意); Weekly Shounen Champion No.15

聖闘士星矢 THEN III 決意

186367.description: Mukae Jinki have gathered 15 Fighters, and One who have chosen from winning all the Shop Tournaments. These 16 fighters will fight for the throne to be the strongest, as the Curtain for the Second Deluxe Opens!! Who will be the one to Control the fight, who will be the one to win!?

title.native: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード will+Dress D2

186368.description:
One day, 15-year-old saint Alm decides she can no longer stand her boss's power harassment and runs out of the temple. She buys land in an abandoned park, builds a barrier around a bench, and begins a homeless life where she can sleep freely, create food using her holy power, and enjoy the comfortable slow life in the park. On the other hand, the temple, which has lost their saint and is no longer able to function, is in a frenzy!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title.native: 廃公園のホームレス聖女

synonyms: Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam: The Truth of the Thunderbolt of Zeus Project

title.native: 機動戦士クロスボーンガンダム 神の雷計画の真実
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Crossbone Gundam: Kami no Kaminari Keikaku no Shinjitsu

186370.description:
Hee-Soo receives a mysterious note by courier that makes writing curses on others come true. Even cash comes out every time you curse! Hee-Soo curses Hyun-Woo, the man she has a crush on, to force him into a romance with her. However, things don't go as planned, and things go wrong. The situation worsens even further than before, and when someone appears after the note, Hee-Soo is forced to cross a river of no return...

(Source: Naver, translated)

186371.description:
After heroically sacrificing his life to save a child, twenty-five-year-old Koichi Suzuki is reincarnated as a young boy named Thor, born into a harsh, new world, thanks to a mysterious god dubbed “Indeed-Missy.” His reward? A unique magical ability that lets him cook up monsters.

Nothing comes easy in this cruel world, though. After nearly being sold off to slave traders by his scumbag parents, Thor finds himself orphaned and alone at the age of four, forced to scrape by using sheer grit and his newfound culinary skills. Just as survival feels within reach, he discovers two beastfolk girls on the verge of death. Helping them could spell his own ruin, but for a man who adored all things furry-eared in his past life, there's only one path forward.

“There's no way I'm abandoning beast ears!” And so begins Thor's adventure of cooking his way through the dungeon!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Accursed Chef and His Pair of Furry Foodies
title.native: 呪われ料理人は迷宮でモフミミ少女たちを育てます
title.romaji: Noroware Ryourinin wa Meikyuu de Mofumimi Shoujo-tachi wo Sodatemasu

186373.description:
Hyeon may seem like a normal high schooler, but he can see and interact with spirits. While he tries to live a quiet life, everything changes when he meets Jeseung, a classmate obsessed with live-streaming in haunted houses. Soon, Hyeon finds himself visiting eerie places and uncovering a sinister mystery--someone is manipulating spirits, promising to bring them back to life. As he confronts dangerous forces, Hyeon must navigate a dark world he never expected to be part of. Will he uncover the truth before it’s too late?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Why You Shouldn't Enter a Haunted House

186374.description:
There's a stalker next door and a crazy person living upstairs!

Art student Kim Haru runs away from the goshiwon with terrible memories to a shabby one-room apartment. A month after moving in, a suicide occurs next door and a gloomy and suspicious woman moves in. Then one day, when Kim Haru returns home, he encounters the woman next door standing in his room with a kitchen knife...

"Haru... I can do anything for you."

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includesone extra chapter.
synonyms: A Day In The Life Of A Stalker

186375.description:
Veteran adventurer Hakura has overcome countless trials, but his latest fight with a deadly hydra nearly costs him his life. In the nick of time, he is saved by an intriguing young lady named Leen, who, to his surprise, possesses the rare ability to tame any and all monsters! Now indebted to this unscrupulous monstermancer, Hakura decides to join her in her travels, the two of them arguing and bickering every step of the way. What has drawn them together, and what adventures await this unlikely pair?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: 魔物使少女~綠瞳的冒險者~

title.native: 魔物使いの娘 ~緑の瞳の少女~
title.romaji: Mamono Tsukai no Musume: Midori no Hitomi no Shoujo

186376.description:
Even in another world, there are illnesses and clinics?

A doctor that wants to slack off, who takes breaks between appointments and even escapes from the hospital?　

-- A demi-human boy meets a rather unusual doctor. A tale of an eccentric and eccentric doctor in another world!

(Source: Sunday Webry)

synonyms: The Man known as Tsukiji Tobimaru

186378.description:
High schooler Rico is determined to make her grandfather's karate dojo go viral, constantly posting on social media. Just as she's searching for the next trending topic, an alien appears?! A story of an unlikely friendship between an Earthling and a space visitor begins!

(Source: MangaPlus)

title.native: 勇者様、昨夜もお楽しみでしたね。
title.romaji: Yuusha-sama, Sakuya mo Otanoshimi deshita ne.

186381.description:
When Hiroto lustily orders a call boy, it turns out to be Rurikawa, a cool and beautiful honor student who attends the same university as him! Despite it being Rurikawa's first day on the job, Hiroto, who is hopelessly aroused, decides to service Rurikawa...even though he's the customer! Get ready for sucking, licking, pumping, and other creamy fun in this erotic comedy!

(Source: BookLive)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: You ordered a naughty honor student?
title.native: ご注文はエッチな優等生

186382.description:
First story of the Seven Days of Lust - Omegaverse Anthology

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

186383.description:
Second story of the Seven Days of Lust - Omegaverse Anthology

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

186384.description: At Teiou Department Store, there is a goddess who is full of love for lingerie in the women's underwear section. This heartwarming story from BAILA, a fashion magazine with overwhelming support from women in their 30s, encapsulates the real worries and conflicts of working women. Every day, customers visit Ebisu Amane, a charismatic fitter, with worries about underwear selection and their body shape. At first, they are at the mercy of Amane's extraordinary words and actions, but gradually the folds in their hearts begin to unravel... Uni, a master of work-related manga, carefully depicts the feelings of adults living in the modern world, including an office worker whose boyfriend has cheated on her, and same-sex couples. Another highlight of this original manga from a fashion magazine is the detailed knowledge about underwear!

title.native: ランジェリーの女神さま

186385.description:
It’s not easy to be a broke college student who also happens to a bit of a pushover. Scratch that; it’s damn hard. So when Henry receives an offer to make some easy cash, he caves in quickly. The offer? To impersonate his roommate, Felix, and go to addiction counseling in his stead. So Henry joins group counseling and meets Elliot. The most attractive, seductive man Henry has ever seen…who also happens to be a sex addict. Things are about to get a lot harder than Henry bargained for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

186386.description:
To become a top-notch streamer, a reckless girl named Yoru Kihara, also known as "Angel Hell," earns money through extreme streaming. Thanks to the support of her fans, she managed to save up her target amount to move to the city. However, her abusive parents took everything: her savings and her streaming equipment.

In utter despair, Yoru attempts her final act—streaming her own suicide from an abandoned building. But suddenly, she’s attacked by someone wearing a creepy rabbit mask. This marks her fateful encounter with "Streaming War," a grotesque streaming site where underground streamers go to satisfy their insatiable need for recognition!

title.native: ストリーミング・ウォー

186388.description:
Princess Claudia's life should be tragic… pushed from a window by her uncle, coldly ignored, and dismissed by all. But when her past-life memories awaken, she remembers she was Adelheid, a legendary witch who once commanded legions of magicians. Now reborn, she refuses to be anything but herself: fabulously powerful and utterly carefree!

(Source: Titan Manga)
synonyms: Die legendäre Hexe wird als unterdrückte Prinzessin wiedergeboren
The Legendary Witch is Reborn as an Oppressed Princess

title.english: The Legendary Witch Is Reborn as an Oppressed Princess
title.native: 虐げられた追放王女は、転生した伝説の魔女でした
title.romaji: Shiitagerareta Tsuihou Oujo wa, Tenseishita Densetsu no Majo Deshita

186389.description:
Princess Alicia, a blood-stained bride, uses her power of "foresight" to make those around her her ally.

Princess Alicia entered her wedding in a blood-stained wedding dress. Smiling with a dignified demeanor, she tells her husband, the handsome and ruthless crown prince Felix. "--Nice to meet you, traitorous husband." Alicia, whose father, the king, was killed, had everything taken from her by her uncle and sister-in-law. Still, with the power of "foresight," she even uses the fact that she was nearly killed on her wedding journey as a weapon to make those around her her ally. All the while, she keeps her secret, which she should hide above all else, hidden from her husband Felix. If she doesn't get him on her side, Alicia will be killed. Felix shows interest in Alicia, but at the crucial moment, she doesn't know whether he is friend or foe...?

"I'll be your accomplice."

This is the story of a fighting princess who wins what she wants with her own power and obtains happiness. And then, a love story with a cold and beautiful husband who kisses her but doesn't become her ally.

(Source: OVERLAP, translated)
synonyms: Die wiederauferstandene Braut und der grausame Prinz: Ein schurkisches Ehepaar für höhere Ziele

title.native: 死に戻り花嫁は欲しい物のために、残虐王太子に溺愛されて悪役夫妻になります！～初めまして、裏切り者の旦那さま～
title.romaji: Shi ni Modori Hanayome wa Hoshi Mono no Tame ni, Zangyakuou Taishi ni Dekiai Sarete Akuyaku Fusai ni Narimasu! Hajimemashite, Uragirimono no Danna-sama

186390.description:
The protagonist, Sozai Shu, a 26-year-old single man, is a gamer with a natural collecting habit. After losing his life in the joy of obtaining a rare material in a game, he is transported to another world by the power of God.

In order to make life in the other world easier, Shu prays to God for the "power to gather materials at his own pace!" His wish is granted, but somehow the power is strangely strong and convenient!? In a different world full of unknown materials, Shu struggles to gather various materials in order to live a rich and relaxed life of gathering materials!

(Source: Amazon Japan, translated)
synonyms: Shu Sozai was a somewhat odd man who was an obsessive collector of materials. When he lost his life, God led him to another world by divine power
A Relaxed Life of Gathering Materials in Another World

title.native: 異世界のんびり素材採取生活

186391.description:
Hayami, a university student, harbors unspoken feelings for his childhood friend and best friend, Shino. Whether at home or at school, they’re always together. But every day, Hayami carefully conceals his feelings, maintaining a calm facade to avoid giving himself away. One day, however, their dynamic is shaken when Igawa, a handsome new member of their club, starts getting closer to Shino. "I've been holding back my feelings for so long, yet he can just confess so easily..."
Struggling with jealousy, Hayami forces himself to stay in the role of "just a friend." But how long can he hold out before his true emotions come to light?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: お約束のネバーランド　実写映画公開記念！特別番外編
title.romaji: Oyakusoku no Neverland: Jissha Riga Koukai Kinen! Tokubetsu Bangai-hen

186393.description: Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2024 issue 52, 2025 issue 41.

title.native: カグラバチ　番外編　双城厳一のお風呂探訪
title.romaji: Kagurabachi Bangai-hen: Soujou Genichi no Ofuro Tanbou

title.native: お約束のネバーランド

186395.description:
“Humanity will be destroyed by the "Demon King".”

About a month earlier, 800 million lives had already been lost due to the indiscriminate and suspicious deaths that had occurred.

God said that the phenomenon, known as “Soul Peeling,” was caused by the “Demon King,” who looked like an innocent little girl.

Ten angels representing the human race are selected to stop the disaster, and the “holy war” between “mankind” and the “Demon King” begins.

In this world in turmoil, only Kosaka Yuto knew the girl. She has been made an enemy of the world, and she is a weak existence reaching out for help.

For the sake of one girl, he will battle against the whole world.

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)

186396.description:
Second-year high school student Kentaro is spending his first summer vacation with his senior, Mizuki, as a couple. However, with Mizuki busy at his part-time job, they hardly get to see each other. One day, Kentaro’s brother mentions spotting Mizuki working at a bar late at night…!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title.native: セブンティーンシロップス 番外編

186397.description:
"I can't help myself... he's sleeping, but I want to fuck my best friend..!"

Follow the unorthodox magical studies of the unique cast of students in this BL!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ノンクラシック・スクール

186399.description:
Notes:
- Also contains En no Naka no Satsujin Jiken (円の中の殺人事件)

186402.description:
University students Saeki Yosuke and Yano Junya were once mere classmates in high school, not particularly close. However, after Yano—a promising track and field athlete—was forced to give up his dreams due to an injury, Saeki found himself unable to just ignore him. On a whim, he invited Yano to live together while they attended the same university.
“What exactly is this feeling?” As they navigate their unspoken emotions and awkward boundaries, the two gradually find their distance shrinking…

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 明日に続くただいまを

186403.description:
“Did you know that your father is a monster?”

Young Kane is an orphan boy who doesn’t have a penny to his name. He has to resort to petty theft just to get some bread to eat. But out of nowhere appears a mysterious man, Shane White, who promises to take him in and become his adoptive father. Together, they go to the remote island where Shane and his other adopted children live. But this whole thing is definitely odd enough to raise Kane’s suspicions… Still, perhaps finally having a family and living on this idyllic island is enough to overcome all that. Even so, Kane can’t help but wonder just who this Shane is and what his actual intentions are…

(Source: Lezhin US)

186404.description:
“Did I steal this man's lover?”

Seo In-Ho wakes up in a world that he doesn’t recognize. He cannot speak, and can hardly move, but hears voices calling out for him…only, it’s by a name he doesn’t know. Realizing that he has possessed the body of Kacius of this nation’s royal guard. The only person he can rely on is Kacius’s former colleague and lover, Albretto Noe. Determined to not only be protected by, but to protect Albretto, In-Ho begins to fall deeper and deeper into the life of Kacius, until it becomes nigh impossible to differentiate who he truly is any longer…

(Source: Lezhin US)

186405.description:
Shin Giwon has been searching for the reason he became famous: his very first fan. Little does he know, what he’s looking for is a lot closer than he thinks…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ภาพร้อนซ่อนอดีต

186407.description:
Makise likes Sakai, a lively girl in his class, but he has a hard time telling her how he really feels about her. One morning, Makise woke up and found himself in a "parallel world".

The differences from the original world are that the school uniform is the school run and the classes move slowly, and Sakai is my girlfriend.

This is a coming-of-age love story of junior high school students who move back and forth between two worlds!

title.romaji: Heikou Sekai no Kimi Kimi Boku Boku

186408.description:
1. Katte ni More Better (勝手にモアベター)
2. Sea Feaver
3. Soumon (相聞)
4. Hai Anxiety (ハイ・アングザイエティ)
5. Good Luck (グッドラック)

186409.description:
1. Aki no Hi ni Rhapsody (秋の日にラプソディー)
2. Micro Cosmos (ミクロコスモス)
3. Strange Blue (ストレンジ・ブルー)
4. Boy (ボーイ)
5. Lady JANE de Kampai (Lady JANE で乾杯)

title.native: 秋の日にラプソディー

186410.description: Notes: - Also includes the one-shot Omoi ga Todoku Nara (想いがとどくなら)

186412.description:
Toro Hazumi has opened the baked sweets specialty store of his dreams. However, he is devastatingly bad at serving customers! Those who happens to visit will be scared of him and run away, making it difficult to run the business. One day, just before he decides to close the store for good, a mysterious high school girl, Mikuru, appears. For some reason, she's not afraid of him and her praise for his baked sweets, ignites the long-lost passion in Toro's heart once again...

A heatwarming everyday comedy of a socially awkward man and outgoing girl begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ベイク・ベイク・ベイク

186413.description:
When lifelong criminal Seung-Ji finds herself betrayed by her old boss, she joins an upstart smuggling business to lay low. Her goal is to find the opening to take advantage of the business to score cash and flee the city, but a wrench by the name of Yeong-Won is thrown into her plans. Inexperienced and naive, Yeong-Won is working in her aunt’s stead as Seung-Ji’s superior. Falling in love is a luxury for people in their line of work, but Seung-Ji’s desire for financial gain might be changing into a desire for something that she can’t afford...

(Source: Tappytoon)

186414.description: Manga adaptation of Indian movie Baahubali 2: The Conclusion.

186415.description:
Joon-hwi has always been a beta. Which is a relief, given how his best friend and nationally beloved actor Seok-hyun hates omegas, and there’s no way Joon-hwi’s crush on him would be requited otherwise. But one day, when Joon-hwi discovers he might be the exact thing Seok-hyunh hates, everything spirals out of control…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes a prologue.
synonyms: A Small Place: The Beginning of Summer

186416.description:
Maki, a shy girl, has lost her beloved senior to her friend Rumi. Jealous of the proactive Rumi, Maki has an eerie dream in which a woman's severed head speaks. "I'm a mermaid... eat me... and you'll surely become beautiful." Maki, who has listened to the mermaid's whisper, is faced with a shocking future...!? In addition to the title story, this masterpiece collection of short stories includes the mermaid series "Siren" and "The Sea Where Mermaids Live," "The Flower's Name," which depicts liberation from the curse of the past, and "The Dream Continues," which depicts the tragedy brought about by love and hate!

(source: Amazon.jp, translated)

title.native: 裏教師~背徳の淫悦授業~
title.romaji: Ura Kyoushi: Haitoku no Inetsu Jugyo

title.native: バスターティーチャー彩香―妖魔学園の美少年
title.romaji: Buster Teacher Ayaka: Youma Gakuen no Bishounen

186420.description:
The story is set in Japan, 700 years after the age of swords and magic, where science has replaced magic. Social problems caused by magic and magical beasts are on the rise, and the Metropolitan Police Department establishes the Metropolitan Police Department's Magical Beast Control Division to deal with them. Kamishima Jingo, a werewolf (lycanthrope), is investigating a horrific case as a detective in the Magical Beast Control Division.

Meanwhile, the great elven sage Sajuel, who had been asleep for 700 years in preparation for the return of the Demon King, wakes up. However, the Demon King was resurrected and defeated 40 years ago. Sajuel is shocked to learn this, but he lends his wisdom to the Magical Beast Control Division and begins investigating with Kamishima and the others. A fantasy of magic and police unfolds.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Metropolitan Police Department Beast Control Office: Wolf Detective and Awakened Sage

title.native: 警視庁魔獣対策室 狼刑事と目覚めの賢者
title.romaji: Keishichou Majuu Taisakushitsu Ookami Keiji to Mezame no Kenja

186421.description:
With her model-like height, Towako attracts attention wherever she goes. However, she is actually more timid than anyone else and wishes to live a quiet life without attracting attention. But then, Towako is approached by a boy with a sparkling aura!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Mazuwa, Hokori wo Otoshimasen ka (まずは、ほこりを落としませんか)".

title.native: 十羽子さんの背中は広い

186422.description:
1. The Hamlet Jikenchou (サー・ハムレット事件帳)
2-3. Kakutou wa Moeteiru ka (角燈は燃えているか)

title.native: サー・ハムレット事件帳

186423.description:
All Colonel Kang Hajeong wants is to retire peacefully from the Esper & Guide Special Forces, but his plans are ruined when he’s partnered with a powerful new esper named Kim Muhyeok. Worse yet, a sudden ambush cuts his life tragically short… or does it? Waking up in the hospital years later, he finds himself in the body of Sergeant Kang, a different person who happens to share the same name. But that’s not the only mystery to be solved. Strange things are happening at the Esper/Guide center, and his old partner, Kim Muhyeok, still needs his help…

(Source: Tappytoon)

186424.description:
Years have passed since Nakki left Japan. At Narita Airport, a pair of young twins disembark. Tobio, who happens to be there, takes it upon himself to escort them to their guardian. As he drives towards Tokyo with the children, he remains unaware of their true identity...

(Source: Manga-Updates)

186425.description:
A raging storm! The newlyweds face new upheaval!

It's November, two years after Chiyo was born. Tsubaki's heart flutters when he receives a letter from his real father, the head of the Takigawa family. However, he hides this and goes on a honeymoon to Kyoto with Nao. While spending their sweet trip alone, a certain encounter changes their fate...!?

(Source: Be-Love, translated)
