186428.description:
"I want you to heal the emperor with your tea." Kaedeka, who aims to become the legendary tea master Ming-sei who supported the Dragon Kingdom, is brought to the emperor's bedroom!? But the emperor, Kou-kei, has closed his heart off to her...

The long-awaited comic adaptation of a Chinese-style love fantasy between a ruthless emperor and a novice tea master!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

186429.description:
Karin is the reincarnation of the legendary queen who built peace for a thousand years. She was meant to live like an ordinary person, but when she learns that her younger brother, who was chosen as the new king, is in danger, she decides to enter the royal palace! There, she happens to meet Shion, the king of a neighboring country and the love of her life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

186430.description:
It was the happiest day in the world." Our sad and fleeting "love with a deadline" has begun.

In the winter of his freshman year of high school, Akito Hayasaka is diagnosed with a heart disease and told that he has little time left to live. In the midst of despair, Akito meets Sakurai Haruna, who is hospitalized at the hospital. Haruna, too, is seriously ill and has only a few days left to live. Akito begins to talk with her, hiding his illness, and becomes interested in Haruna, who says she is not afraid of dying. Can I still be in love with her?　 The days that pass by as he asks himself these questions begin to change?

The story is the ultimate story of pure love, with a sense of fragile beauty and tenderness in their daily lives, which are depicted in a lighthearted manner.

title.native: 余命一年と宣告された僕が、余命半年の君と出会った話
title.romaji: Yomei Ichinen to Senkokusareta Boku ga, Yomei Hantoshi no Kimi to Deatta Hanashi

186431.description:
Copywriter Seon Jaewon has been losing his mind over a rival social media account that keeps parodying his creative ads. He’s ready to kill whoever is behind it, but not before he’s “killed” in bed by his hot neighbor, Lee Hyeonjin. After an impulsive first night together, the two men quickly hit it off, and Jaewon feels like he might finally see some sparks fly in his loveless life. Well, as long as this perfect man doesn’t turn out to be his worst enemy or anything. But what are the chances of that... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

186432.description:
Sairin, whose status was lowered due to her late father's involvement in being arrested for treason, became the princess of Kihanabo. She tries to clear her father's name, but her purpose is discovered by the prince, Oren. However, he asks her for help in his revenge, and she ends up posing as his favorite concubine...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 喜花坊の寵姫 恋と縁は宴より始めよ

186433.description:
Touko, a country princess who grew up in Kumano, is ordered by her noble father, whom she has never met, to become the Saio of Ise, where she serves the gods every day. However, due to a curse incident caused by her father, she is relieved of her duties and is able to return to Kumano. However, her joy is short-lived when she is told that she has been chosen to marry the Crown Prince. However, it seems that there is something shady about her marriage to the Crown Prince...?

A comic adaptation of this unsettling Heian period love story!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

186434.description:
Today is Friday. The reward for working hard this week is... a board game and a crush! Mari, who is expressionless and often misunderstood, and Namishima, whose feelings are easily revealed on his face, have been dating for almost a year. On Friday nights, the two enjoy playing board games after work! A weekend filled with board games and pure love, woven together by two polar opposites.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Lucius is her former fiance and currently the Emperor's favorite knight whose life had been ruined by her own father six years ago. Is this forced marriage the beginning of Lucius' vengeance? Could fate turn it into a second chance for them to get over the shadows of their painful past and find true love?

One day, a lord of the spirit world is gravely injured, but he was saved by the scion of a merchant family, Kageaki. Kageaki felt guilty about forcing himself on her… but he eventually becomes genuine attracted to the maiden. Likewise, while unwilling at first, Juju cannot resist the pleasure of sex and yearns for more.

A pure-love tale about two people coming together under awkward circumstances.

(Source: Pillow, translated)

186446.description:
"Don't Underestimate an Older Man's Desire!" — A Love-Struck Young Man Helps an Older Man Feel Young Again!

Rihito, who secretly has a crush on the handsome older man Maki, whom he met at the station, finds himself invited to dinner. During their conversation, Rihito learns that Maki is trying to feel young again. Eager to help, Rihito initially only intended to offer support but ends up confessing his feelings for Maki. Flustered, Rihito is met with Maki's reaction—"You're just too cute," Maki says as he pulls Rihito into an embrace. Lost in what feels like a dream, Rihito proposes the wild idea of a "younger-man play," and Maki passionately makes love to him all night long.

(Source: Coolmic)

The intensity of office worker Himari's lust has been a constant thorn in her side. It's the reason things never worked out with her ex-boyfriends and has left her traumatized and frustrated. When her best friend from college and now coworker Kazumi is sat listening to her worries, in a drunken stupor Himari blurts out that she wants a man who can make love to her until she's truly satisfied. Upon hearing this, Kazumi suggests that she let him have a shot at it, and Himari's heart skips a beat as she suddenly sees him as a man for the first time. His kiss and touch are gentle, and as her loins hunger for him she can barely hold back her moans...! With Himari's body now overcome by pleasure, can these two ever go back to being just friends after this...?

186490.description:
Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

(Source: WEBTOON)

186491.description: One-shot published in Bikkuri House August 1983.

186492.description: One-shot published in Fantasy Literature Journal Vol. 2 special issue: Cthulhu Club (1987).

186498.description:
A newly awakened guide slash cafe owner fights an uphill battle trying to protect her business from a handsome yet explosive esper, who finds both her and her powers as addicting as caffeine.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Cafe Owner is an S-Class Guide

186499.description:
The complete backstory of Japanese cuisine explained in richly illustrated manga style!

This book explores the fascinating history, lore and practice of Japanese cooking through the eyes of Manabu, a young man who aspires to become a professional Japanese chef. Each chapter presents a new set of topics which help the reader to appreciate the great depth and complexity of Japan's amazing food culture.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)
synonyms: Manga de Wakaru Nihon Ryori no Joushiki: Nihon no Shoku Bunka no Genten to Naze? ga Hito Me de Wakaru

186501.description:
A catgirl is teased by her catboy classmate everyday. He calls her "shortie" and teases her time and time again.

But one day... she's had ENOUGH!

Grabbing him, they both lose their balance and fall over! She thinks that he is going to shout ab*se at her... but the catboy squashed beneath her is acting odd...?

Goaded on by a cocky classmate, the two end up having their first time together!

(Source: DLsite)

title.english: Boy For Bottom. Catgirl x Catboy
title.native: ♂が受け。ネコちゃん×ネコくん

186502.description:
We began to dream of a world of children's beauty and happiness, sweetness of the music of color and shape, a world of feeling and meaning, a world at its best— of delicious disaster and heartrending sorrow.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 懐かしい年への手紙: Graduation
title.romaji: Natsukashii Toshi e no Tegami: Graduation

186503.description:
Gi-ryeo has a secret: he's really an alien from another world! As High Wizard of the planet Alpha Uri, Gi-ryeo slaved away day in and day out working his soul crushing job. But, after perfecting his transmigration magic, Gi-ryeo escapes into the body of a starved Hunter on Earth. On a new planet, surrounded by more magic than he's ever known, can Gi-ryeo adapt and keep his identity hidden from those seeking the High Wizard?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Delusional Hunter in Another World
The Hunter of the Other World Who Is Being Misunderstood
เชื่อเถอะ ฉันเป็นฮันเตอร์ห่วยแตก
被誤認為S級的異世界獵人

186504.description:
Min Hu-Chu, a guy who lives to eat and So Geum-Ji, a girl who eats to live. They’re both childhood friends but with complete different opinions on the purpose of food. Focusing on these two characters, introducing a story that includes recipes to make alone(?) and their campus life(!)

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

186505.description:
Dian is a writer who struggles to make a living. One day, a famous singer, Eda, shows up and asks for the return of the blue leather described in Dian's novel. Dian, a fan of Eda, tries to return the leather she returned when she rejected his proposal, but hears that her fiance has already left on a journey with the leather and the pain of heartbreak.

When they are about to part ways, her aunt, who is urging her to get married, comes and suffocates Dian... Dian sees Eda's hand reaching out to her like a sip of oxygen, and she takes her hand to go on a journey together to find the leather.

Dian, who wants to succeed as a writer despite being a woman, and Eda, who is obsessed with leather and the sea. As the nights they spend together grow longer, the two begin to fall in love with each other's stories and eyes...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

186506.description:
Lee Myeong-Jun, Vice Chairman of Hyundo Group, lost his daughter to the Iljin group. For revenge, he adopts Yoon Ga-Ram, a psychopathic North Korean defector. She is a sadistic human weapon born after North Korea's drug experiments. A psychopath girl who killed everyone at the lab and escaped North Korea alone. Yoon Ga-Ram has just been released from a juvenile detention center in South-Korea.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
synonyms: สนามเด็กล่า

186508.description:
After tragically losing his parents, Yijun was left with only his older sister to rely on. Working endlessly at a part-time job to pay his college tuition, he meets Sang-hyeon, a man who seems to have it all. Effortlessly composed, mature, and financially secure, Sang-hyeon possesses a calm magnetism that Yijun cannot help but admire. Admiration soon blossoms into an intense, passionate romance. However, frequent arguments centered around Yijun's sister create a deep rift between them, eventually driving him to push Sang-hyeon away. Just as Yijun tries to move on, Sang-hyeon delivers a devastating announcement: he is marrying Yijun’s sister. Now, the man who once held Yijun's heart is about to become his brother-in-law, entangling them in a dangerous web of longing, resentment, and forbidden desire. When the line between past love and present betrayal blurs, they are brought closer than brothers ever should be.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hyeong, na Keojyeosseo! Yeokkijap BL Danpyeonseon (형, 나 커졌어! 역키잡 BL 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [형, 나 커졌어! 역키잡 BL 단편선] 매형
[Hyung, I've Grown Up! Yeokkijab BL Anthology] Brother-in-Law
[Brother, I've Grow Up! Reverse Key Job BL Short Story Collection] Brother-in-law

186509.hashtag: #それでも推しをきらいになれない

title.native: それでも推しをきらいになれない
title.romaji: Soredemo Oshi wo Kirai ni Narenai

186510.description:
Kai spends his days as a sugar baby. One day he's saved by Yuuma who happens to be around while he was having an argument with a client. Kai immediately notices Yuuma's refined appearance and kind spirit, and asks him to be his "sugar daddy. Surprisingly, Yuuma, who's eager to experience new things, accepts Kai's proposal. As time goes by, Kai starts feeling attracted to Yuuma, who, unlike his other "daddies," respects him and takes care of him. Despite these acts, there's a reason why Kai can’t fully trust him...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Tell me the temperature of love

title.romaji: Ai no Ondo wo Oshiete yo

synonyms: Melt your heart with the temperature of love

title.native: 愛の温度でとかしたい

186512.description:
Seeking a bad guy worthy of being her servant, Eclair goes to a police box out in the countryside. There she spots a serious cop who has a villainous look to him, Kuwabara Daichi. Eclair wants to bring Daichi down to the underworld, but Daichi just wants to send her back there. Their love is war…! Or maybe Eclair is a fool and Daichi just can’t leave her be.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

186513.description:
Atsushi Saito and his wife, Yuko, are about to start a new chapter of their lives. Yuko is nearly ready to give birth, and Atsushi diligently visits her at the hospital where she’s staying. Atsushi is on one such visit when a mysterious, parasitic wasp that targets pregnant women appears! Faced with this unprecedented horror, can Atsushi protect his beloved wife and their unborn child…?

(Source: Silent Manga Audition)

186514.description:
Tatsuhiko inherits his grandfather's home after his passing. It's been ages, so he heads to the old homestead for a visit. In a storage room there, he encounters a tanuki who claims to be a god. Tatsuhiko and the tanuki god repair the home together while sharing stories about his grandfather. Following this strange turn of events, the two decide to get married?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

186515.description:
Scary stories tend to hide what's truly within an author's heart. What exactly could this truth be, as it comes to light between author and listener...? Frightening yet gentle, eerie yet warm. A new and exciting therapeutic horror story takes the stage!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: こころの一番暗い部屋

186516.description:
Years after a dragon fell in Edo city... The city rebuilt itself alongside the dragon. When samurai from the Matsumichi domain heard that a cure for the plague existed within the dormant dragon's body, they ventured inside. There, they encountered a man tasked with managing and exploring the dragon...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186517.description:
Nobody on the continent hasn't heard of the evil deeds of the great outlaw M. Godspeed. But one day, a young man claiming to be the criminal's son suddenly appears trekking through the harsh desert. This Jim Godspeed says he's killed his father and has the corpse to prove it! A steampunk western from the mind of the master, Boichi!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186518.description:
Despite her artistic talent, Sakai is a young girl traumatized by social interactions. When Ikeda, the class's natural mood-maker, suddenly starts talking to her, everything begins to change... A sensitive 59-page coming-of-age drama exploring teenage inner conflicts.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186519.description:
Meet S'more Milwalky, a genius scientist at Deslike Prison, otherwise known as Dead End Prison. S'more has been grinding away nonstop with research and work, leaving her little chance to fall in love. However, one fateful day, when the executed assassin known as "Painkiller" is brought into her lab, S'more accidentally uses her Secret Elixer on him...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.native: ラブイズオーバーキル

186520.description:
Rio Mikazuki is a shinobi. That is, a shinobi living in the modern worldーa "shinewbi" of sorts. All of the ninjutsu and ninja tools of the current era are at her immediate disposal and are considerably more high-tech than before. However, it seems as though her senior partner, Igarashi, has learned how to use real ninjutsu through the long-forgotten traditional training methods of the old shinobi... The stage unfolds for a romantic comedy of two shinobi working in a modern world!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186521.description:
Eunuchs, the only men allowed to serve in the secret garden known as the harem. When a young eunuch named Jafar encounters three beautiful sisters there, their meeting shakes the country to its foundations! Brought to you by the tag-team of Kotaro Shono, the artist of World's End Harem, and Kei Saikawa, the creator of Hero Organization, a tale of suspense in a beautiful, otherworldly country unfolds!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186523.description:
When Mitsu was in high school, he had a physical relationship with his childhood friend Nana, whom he had a crush on. However, when Nana suddenly asked him, "Do you want to stop doing this kind of thing?" Mitsu was unable to tell him that he didn't like it, and ended up heartbroken. Mitsu has not been in contact with Nana since then, but his feelings for him still remained. When Mitsu became a university student, he runs into him again while working part-time. He is relieved to find that he doesn't seem to notice him, but short after, he is ambushed at the end of his shift and they end up going to Mitsu's house together. There, Nana shows his obsession with Mitsu for some reason. While the memory of his hurt returns to him, Mitsu's feelings for him still remain…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
186523.hashtag: #嫌だと言ってモラトリアム

title.native: 嫌だと言ってモラトリアム

186525.description:
I thought I lost everything to my best friend, Valietta, but I didn’t expect I’d lose my husband to her as well. I, Sierra Brilloxen, was too naive to see that her copying me wasn’t affection—it was obsession. I shattered and decided to end it all. But somehow, I was given a second chance—seven years in the past. This time, I won’t let her get rid of me. I’ll take back everything she stole and show her no mercy for the pain she caused.

(Source: Tapas)

186526.description:
Toshio, who was created by modifying the body of a boy into a cyborg designed for sex - was taken in by Shindou, the person who takes care of him. Toshio spends his peaceful days doing chores, and waiting for the arrival of his beloved Shindou.

In the picture diary that Shindou bought for him, Toshio draws his everyday life filled with “fun” and “love”. All of these were given to him by Shindou…

Human x Cyborg BL - A happy picture diary volume.

186527.description:
Toshio, who was created by modifying the body of a boy into a cyborg designed for sex - was taken in by Shindou, the person who takes care of him. Toshio spends his peaceful days doing chores, and waiting for the arrival of his beloved Shindou.

However, while cleaning up Shindou’s belongings after they move out, Toshio happens to find a certain picture…

Human x Cyborg BL - The awaited sequel volume.

186528.description:
A mother who killed her own child and committed suicide. A cold father who is absorbed in her work and doesn't care about her daughters. Murasaki and Kaho, twin high school sisters with such parents, lived in a small world isolated from society. One day, on a street corner, Hanaho meets a mysterious young man who disguises himself as a pastor, calls himself "Master,'' and runs the religious organization "Mary Magdalene.'' Kaho leaves home and travels around Japan with the young man. However, the young man was also a swindler who sold tap water as the water of life. Still, she ends up following him. I felt like he could take me somewhere other than here.

Note: This manga was inspired by the real pseudo-religion/cult named "Jesus' Ark".

186530.description:
Wishing for the return of the EuroPara's original idols, the Prisiennes, Shikyouin Hibiki begins a little "play" in secret from Fuwari and Falulu. In addition to the new characters, familiar faces will make a guest appearance as well. "Come, fall with me into nighttime PriPara!" With the rich aroma of casblanca filling the air, the curtain rises!

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 紫京院ひびきの華麗なるお遊戯

186531.description:
After meeting a sad death as a Korean teenager in her past life, nothing could be better than being reincarnated as Livia Hote, a beloved princess of the fire kingdom. A life of only luxury and peace awaited her as the novel's supporting character. However, she eventually realizes that she must learn to control her ever-growing fire powers and she can only do so with the prince of the ice kingdom. Thus, Livia will now have to deal with new uncertainties and relationships that could disrupt her plans to live a peaceful new life…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Becoming Bestfriends With the Cold Male Lead

title.english: Becoming Best Friends With the Icy Male Lead
title.native: 氷の国の皇太子と親友になろうとしたのに
title.romaji: Koori no Kuni no Koutaishi to Shinyuu ni Naru Uto Shita no ni
