title.native: クリ吸引とピストンの子宮責めを同時にできるアイテム
title.romaji: Kuri Kyuuin to Piston no Shikyuu Seme wo Douji ni Dekiru Item

186533.description:
A samurai is someone who serves others and is loyal. The orders of his master are absolute, with no exceptions -- a warrior burdened with sorrow who obeys the princess's orders too faithfully! Kirimaru! Obedient!

(Source: Sunday Webry)

186534.description:
I have a terrible sense of direction, and I've come back to life in a grave!? I need to get out right now... but I'm sure I'm digging upwards now, right? Where is the end of the road?! A spectacle of getting lost, "One chance, one mistake"!!!

(Source: Sunday Webry)

Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Sunday 2024 issue 18.

title.romaji: Houkou Onchi no Michi no Hate

186535.description:
The only way to fight the monsters that appear in the town is a boy named Kishida Youta. The price of his giant size is that he disappears from people's memories. This is the forgotten heroic tale of a boy who once had many friends.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.native: ピンクが好きなヤンキーの話
title.romaji: Pink ga Suki na Yankee no Hanashi

186539.description: She thought she could do any job, but can she really live up to that expectation...?

186543.description:
A world where real-time automatic translation machines have taken hold. The languages ​​and cultures of ethnic minorities are being eliminated. A lyrical science fiction that captures the moment a language goes into a long slumber.

(Source: Torch, translated)

Note: Winner of the 4th Torch Manga Award.

title.native: サピア＝キッズ・モノローグ

186544.description:
Lynn has never had an easy life. A beautiful girl with pale silver hair resembling that of the Empire's princess, she is sold to work in the Dukedom of Ereuputh. Elizabeth, the duke's daughter, harbors jealousy towards the princess and takes pleasure in causing Lynn to suffer. Despite enduring in silence, Lynn's life takes a turn when Martin, the young master of the dukedom, returns. He shows her kindness and she falls for him, knowing that it will only lead to heartbreak. Unable to resist, Lynn shares a passionate night with him, unaware that Martin is not the kind boy she used to know. For he's had a taste of her, and he will never let her go...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: 하녀는 더 이상 그를 원하지 않는다

title.english: The Maid No Longer Desires her Master
title.native: 侍女はもう彼を求めない
title.romaji: Jijo wa Mou Kare wo Motomenai

186545.description:
One year after the end of the zombie outbreak that swept through Korea, Doyoung, who lost her younger brother to a zombie, one day accidentally meets Jion, a student who closely resembles the zombie that bit her brother.

A friendship full of suspicion between two people that continues in a risky manner. Can this relationship last?

(source: Lezhin, translated)

186546.description:
I spent one night with the man who destroyed my country. Then, I ran away with his child in my arms. I think that’s the end of my relationship with him…

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 帝国の黒き狼は亡国の王女に愛を乞う

186547.description:
Violence, extortion, online mob attacks, forced compensated dating, even gang rape... The reality of “bullying” occurring in the so-called “battlefield” of schools is only growing more severe. Yet, no matter how serious the situation becomes, schools and education boards only sweep it under the rug.Teachers, parents, classmates: no one can be relied upon. A new hero has emerged to rescue children trapped in this abyss of despair: the “Bullying Detective”.

Here stands a new hero confronting the disease eroding Japanese society!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: Harcèlement scolaire - La Méthode du détective Imamura

186548.description:
Everyone knows Duke Windzorice is a cold, powerful man, but for the young saint Lilliette, he's a kind adult and just the person to save her from the Temple's abuse! After healing his eyes, Lilliette is granted a home at Windzorice Castle, but the Temple's not willing to let her go. That's when the duke comes up with a foolproof plan to keep her by his side... They'll say she's his daughter! Can this fake family vanquish the Temple and live in peace? Or will the little saint suffer once more?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Saintess Became the Daughter of the Northern Duke
聖女は冷徹公爵の娘になりました

title.english: The Little Saint and the Grand Duke of the North

186549.description:
Of all the things to wake up as, a squirrel is the last thing she expected. Sure, she’s technically a divine beast from a novel, but she’s a squirrel all the same. Determined to make the best of it, Momo—Inky—whatever her name is now—gets to work. And while she thought a little kindness would be enough to keep Yohan from villainy, she didn’t think it would lead to a new human life as Yurika, a caring family, love... or the kind of secrets that could change everything the world has ever known.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became a Squirrel Seeking for the Villain

title.english: I Became the Squirrel That Saves the Villain

186550.description:
As the transmigrated ancestor of Do-Yool, her favorite novel character, Seol-Ryeon tries to arrange everything to make his life easier. But when she reincarnates as Ye-Rin, his young bride, she finds that something has gone wrong over the years. The Frost Palace has fallen on hard times, and its people are suffering. Together with her new husband, she must right wrongs and root out the corruption that has befallen this once-great family. But how much can two young people do alone?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Young Wife of the Martial Arts Novel's Male Lead

title.english: I Became the Young Wife of the Male Lead of a Martial Arts Novel
title.native: 무협지 남주의 어린 아내가 되어 버렸다
title.romaji: Muhyeopji Namjuui Eorin Anaega Doeeo Beoryeotda

186551.description:
Se-Jun is your average human. Wait, no, hold up. He’s a rich college student disowned by his family for being gay, but he’s only human…but will he stay that way? Jae-Hee, his tutor, just might be able to teach him a thing or two about a new life as something else entirely.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Dimise Tutor ~The Teachings of the Vampire~
ディマイズ・チューター～ヴァンパイアの教え～

186552.description:
Jaheon comes from a lineage of omegas. Omegas who have raised the children of their branch families, only for them to be offered to the Snake God, Lord Mugo, every 12 years. Though it is said that Mugo handpicks his sacrifices no one in the head family believes such an old tale anymore. However, Jaheon knows that Lord Mugo came to him when he was a child and picked him to be the sacrifice, and even remembers the events of the day.

Even though Jaheon has prepared himself, both body and mind, for as long as he could remember, upon entering Mugo's lair he quickly realizes that he doesn't want to be eaten as a sacrifice, at least not after finding out the "Lord Mugo" he adored was just one of the snake god's three personalities. Will the Snake God take pity on his sacrifice? Or will Jaheon be swallowed whole?

(Surce: Lezhin US)
synonyms: สามีบรรณาการ

186553.description:
Yu Seolu is an anomaly of an omega with no pheromones, which is why he never expects any alpha to show interest in him. Certainly not a royal alpha like Baek Doha, any less. But once he’s caught Doha’s attention, Seolu can’t seem to escape from it. And then one night, after he finds himself pregnant with Doha’s child, Seolu finds the chance to flee from Doha’s obsession once and for all…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: รักใต้อาณัติ

186554.description:
Jeong-Ueom has avoided his arranged marriage for years, but with mounting pressure from the other family, he can no longer delay. Yet, his heart has already been claimed by someone irreplaceable—his younger brother, Dong-Im. Dong-Im is not only Jeong-Yeom’s forbidden love but also the one Jeong-Yeom has kept by his side, no matter the cost. In the biting chill of winter, longing for a spring that may never come, Jeong-Yeom finds himself once again drawn to Dong-Im’s room.

“Dear brother, how does it feel? How does it feel to marry my woman?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in english.

186555.description:
In the year 2045, Earth has been invaded from four different worlds. To defend itself, Earth must conquer the dungeons that connect to the other worlds. Each nation selects a "delver" to take on that duty, and Japan chooses Gunma, an ordinary guy who suddenly finds himself dispatched to the front lines! Heavily armed and terrified, and activating his "listening carefully" and "enemy detection" skills, he encounters the world's strongest beauty. "Shall we shower ourselves with blood together?" "Strategic retreat, plz!" She's wicked strong but has tofu for brains, and they advance through the dungeon with unstoppable momentum...? An untrodden dungeon fantasy where everything gets mowed down with ease!

(Source: TO Books, translated)
synonyms: Dungeon Wars with You and Me

title.native: 俺と君達のダンジョン戦争@COMIC
title.romaji: Ore to Kimitachi no Dungeon Sensou @COMIC

186556.description:
Shiro loves Zen, the gangster boss who is a handsome herbivorous human (with horns). Shiro wants to be a member of the gang, and he honestly tries to help the boss. But as is often the case with carnivorous humans (with tails), it is so easy for him to pick up fights, which always end up causing trouble for Zen. But why does Shiro have such a short temper? Maybe because Shiro is in heat! As he does not have much knowledge about sex, Zen offers him a technical help for his musterbation. While doing it, Zen's facial expression is very calm, but the action gets more and more exciting and passionate... He is doing this as a kind of treatment, isn't he? But now, it looks like they are having a real love affair!

(Source: Takeshobo)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ガンギマリ発情パンチライン

186558.description:
Azadin, a member of the cursed Messenger Clan, is born with the worst of curses. Lacking magical prowess, he becomes the lowest-ranking messenger, wandering the continent collecting gold coins in hopes of breaking his curse. But when his twin uncovers a great conspiracy, how will he face the impending doom?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: The Shadowed Legacy of the Soulless Messenger

186560.description:
The beauty even more exquisite, and the sinister even more evil!

A special edition of stories in full color carefully selected by the author is now available! The coloring was supervised by the author down to the smallest detail, resulting in a new collection of self-selected masterpieces. Please enjoy these works with even more charm.

(Source: Asahi, translated)

title.native: 伊藤潤二自薦傑作集 Dark Colors
title.romaji: Itou Junji Jisen Kessakushuu: Dark Colors

186562.description:
A book collecting essays, travel photos, illustrations, and manga about and inspired by the Vienna Boys choir.

1. Auf Wiedersehen (アウフ・ヴィーダーゼーエン)
2. Andrea (アンドレア)
3. Wien Kyousoukyoku (ウィーン協奏曲)
synonyms: アウフ・ヴィーダーゼーエン

186563.description:
Moon Geun-Young has the worst luck imaginable, relying entirely on fortune apps to navigate life. His world takes an unexpected turn when he meets Team Leader Kang Joon-Suk, a man blessed with incredible luck.
Every time Geun-Young tries to get intimate, strange interruptions seem to arise. However, with Joonsuk, he finds himself having surprisingly enjoyable nights... that is, until he learns.... "Who knew he was married?"
Will Geun-Young be able to resist the subtle temptations of Kang Joon-Suk, who keeps inching closer—even at work?

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)
synonyms: ลักกี้ไอเทมของวันนี้คือคุณนั่นแหละครับ

186564.description:
I, Seo Tae-Pyung, ended up transmigrating as the younger brother of the heroine in the fantasy romance novel Celestial Love. As romantic as this place is supposed to be, I was too busy just trying to adapt to my new life. Romance? Yeah, right. My goal was to keep a low profile and live quietly… But then… “How could you make the crown princess fall for you of all people?!” At that point, I had no idea. I was only just beginning to scrape the surface of this bizarre turn of events…

(Source: Kakao Page, translated)
synonyms: Surviving in a Romance Fantasy Novel

186565.description:
A cute guy with an angelic face? Check. A cold and aloof outsider with a cat? Check. A class full of vampires? Check... Wait, what? All her life, Seon-Ha Shin has lived in the shadow of her sister, Seong-Hye, who is one year older than her. Luckily, there is one thing Seon-Ha does better than her sister -- donating blood! When Seon-Ha gets special admission into a prestigious university as a blood donor, she finally starts to feel like the main character of her life. Little did she know she'd be surrounded by vampires!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

186566.description:
When the powerless thirteenth prince became emperor, he gave his tutor, Yo Yohwa, poison. His reason being his death at the hands of his own master in countless previous lives. The poisoned Yo Yohwa then regresses to an earlier time together with the prince and is determined to get on his good side this time in order to escape. However, the prince already discovered the truth…

“This is crazy. You killed me in the previous lives, and you neglected me in another. Now you’re acting all nice. Are you trying to get away?”

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

186567.description:
She comes calmly and confidently in the face of despair like death

The wind that day was very cold. My cheeks, the tip of my nose, and my toes were cold. In the village at dawn, not even the sound of a car passing by could be heard. The sound of dogs barking and tree branches tangled like threads filled Chaorum. Chao-Rum cried, gritting her teeth without making a sound. Chao-Rum cried like that in the phone booth for dozens of minutes before calling her divorced mother.

(Source: Naver, translated)

186568.description:
The third son of a viscount, Allen Rovene has hated studying since the day he was born. And no wonder—after suddenly regaining the memories of his past life at the age of twelve, he realizes he spent the entirety of his previous life hunched over a desk, studying like a studyholic! Reborn into his dream world of swords and magic, he’s determined to make the most of his second chance by ditching the books and living a carefree, unburdened life—until he realizes the path to freedom has a detour in the form of the most renowned school in the kingdom: the Royal Knight and Mage Academy of Yugria. To become the magic-wielding, sword-swinging adventurer of his dreams, Allen’s going to have to repurpose his well-honed study skills toward one goal—passing the hellish entrance exams and heading to the Royal Academy!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Pens Down, Swords Up: Throw Your Studies to the Wind
title.native: 剣と魔法と学歴社会　～前世はガリ勉だった俺が、今世は風任せで自由に生きたい～
title.romaji: Ken to Mahou to Gakureki Shakai: Zense wa Gariben datta Ore ga, Konse wa Kaze Makase de Jiyuu ni Ikitai

186569.description:
Porter has just been appointed as the new gatekeeper in a remote area far from any conflict. The emotions that Porter has as he spends his long life preparing for the future...

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

186570.description:
Imai has always been victorious in his judo career, and is always striving for results. But after losing to his classmate, Kuruma, he begins to worry and struggle...!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

186571.description:
College student Saki meets his new neighbor on the way to his part-time job. Oboro, who is self-confessed unemployed, appears friendly and sociable but has a mysterious air about him. The two become close until one day Saki finds Oboro almost passed out in front of his apartment! As Oboro refuses an ambulance, Saki takes him in and looks after him, only to learn Oboro's true colors... "Saki, does this feel good?" Oboro thrusts a finger deep inside, finding out the sticky way exactly what his new friend enjoys!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Don't mess with the yakuza! -Broken in by a crime syndicate deputy leader
title.native: 強引ヤクザは触るなキケン！～若頭にハメられました
title.romaji: Gouin Yakuza wa Sawaruna Kiken! - Wakagashira ni Hameraremashita

186572.description:
A bittersweet romantic drama about a gay bar host mama who gave up on his dreams and a gentle nursery teacher. Kosuke had once the big dream of becoming the world's best makeup artist. He spent his days in love with his boyfriend, Akira, a.k.a Tan-chan and they thought they would always be together. Now, several years later, Kosuke works as the mama of a gay bar and Akira works at a nursery school. Before they knew it, their paths had separated. The frustration of not being able to see each other even though they were close by. Promises that could not be kept. Dreams that could not be fulfilled. The past and present are intricately intertwined. Will the day they can laugh together ever come again?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

title.native: 好きなんて言わんといて インディゴ
title.romaji: Suki nante Iwan to Ite: Indigo

186573.description:
After her husband, Duke Arphad, and his knight sacrifice themselves for her, Princess Agnes flees King Sebastian's murderous conquest, only to be captured and suddenly sent three years back in time to her wedding night! Faced with reliving the past, Agnes is determined to save herself and the duke from the king's clutches. With nothing but a daring new scheme and a fierce resolve, can this formerly pampered princess rise up to become the Arphad family's royal savior?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: あなたを守るために私は王になる

186574.description:
Joy, who started working as a maid, ends up serving the prickly-looking Master Iwan. However, she soon discovers the Master's secret... What exactly is the Master's secret...?

(source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: includes 1 extra chapter.

186575.description:
He caresses both the body and the heart. Iroha, the top performer at a women’s escort service, constantly receives requests from female clients burdened with a variety of struggles—heartbreak, sexless relationships, late-in-life virginity, or even genuine romantic infatuation. With his exceptional massage skills and sweet, seductive conversations, Iroha not only soothes their pain but also uncovers the hidden, unconscious desires they themselves were unaware of.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

186576.description:
A young woman, Ariel, is on the run from her brother and lord, Arik. Threatened by an assassin arranged by Arik, she is rescued by a mysterious knight named Verita, and together they flee. To escape Aric's ever-threatening shadow, Ariel learns to fend for herself with Verita's help. Along the way, Ariel learns to lean on Verita even when she feels vulnerable, and to be honest with herself about her feelings...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

186577.description:
Kang Si-Young, a high school graduate who knows how to drive a tractor but doesn't know a thing about math. Due to her parents' sudden wealth from a crop called 'starfruit', she starts preparing for college late, and her life is 'ruined' when she meets Lee Shin-Hwa, a professional tutor from Seoul National University. The sweet story of a prestigious university student and a third-year repeater unfolds in the countryside in the middle of summer.

(Source: Comico Korea, translated)

Note: Bomtoon has both R15 and R19 version in the same page, if your account is verified it will show the R19 version but if not you will view the R15 one.

186578.description:
Mistakes can be corrected later, but misunderstandings may never be resolved. A friend from the past that I ran into on SNS by chance. A relationship that was really close, but ended irreversibly due to a huge misunderstanding. But I, never said anything like that. But I… Couldn’t say anything.

(source: Comico Korea, translated)

186579.description:
Dahong moves into the "Rainbow House" when she had nowhere else to go. Little did she know that the "Rainbow House" was a house for lesbians. Dahong had to lie that she was one too, to get in. What will happen to her life?

(Source: LaLatoon)

186580.description:
"Do you believe in fate?"

'Shin', a potential candidate who could become the absolute god by simply guiding the fate of the 100th human, meets Han Ha-Na, who was being bullied because she is blind.
In the process of helping Han Ha-Na, who has little time left to live, for promotion, he learns that she was the only mistake he had made in the past and that it was the reason she lost her eyesight.

As time passes, Shin comes to truly love Han Ha-Na and tries to right his mistakes.

(source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: My God, the One of Mine

186581.description:
Prosecutor Hyeon Taesik is assigned to the infamous "Haemu Serial Murder Case," the same case in which his twin brother, Hyeon Minsik, was brutally killed. During the investigation, Taesik encounters Mu Inhui, a priest and the prime suspect. Despite his growing suspicions, Taesik finds himself inexplicably drawn to Inhui. Unbeknownst to him, everything has been orchestrated by Inhui—and Taesik is walking right into his trap...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 聖印の乙女～元薬学研究員だった侯爵令嬢は婚約辞退してハイヒーラーを目指します～
title.romaji: Seiin no Otome: Moto Yakugaku Kenkyuuin datta Koushaku Reijou wa Konyaku Jitai Shite High Healer wo Mezashimasu

title.native: 私のかわいい犬だから

synonyms: A Woman Who Is Too Honest Despite Her Kyoto Dialect
A Girl Who Is Too Honest Despite Her Kyoto Dialect

title.native: 京都弁なのに正直すぎる女
title.romaji: Kyoto-ben na no ni Shoujiki Sugiru Onna

title.native: 世間だと大怪獣は防衛組織が倒した事になっているけど、実際は陰キャにくすぶっている高校生が葬っている ～平穏を望みたい怪獣殺し～
title.romaji: Seken da to Dai Kaijuu wa Bouei Soshiki ga Taoshita Koto ni Natte Iru kedo, Jissai wa Inkya ni Kusubutte Iru Koukousei ga Houmutte Iru - Heion wo Mozombite Kaijuu Koroshi

186588.description:
Long ago, the Kingdom of Wizrain was established by a great hero and his precious dragon. But Elna’s no hero. She’s just the daughter of a nobleman’s mistress, adopted into her father’s family only to be tormented by her stepmother and stepsister. Or so she thinks…until one day, it all comes flooding back—echoes of her past life as a dragon! Spurred on by memories of soaring through the sky with her hero, she heads for the royal palace. A single look into the eyes of the young king, Vaide, tells Elna that he is her beloved hero reborn. Only one problem: He doesn’t remember her at all!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Tale of the Wizrain Kingdom: The Dragon Is the Bride
title.native: ウィズレイン王国物語～竜が花嫁～
title.romaji: Wizrain Oukoku Monogatari: Ryuu ga Hanayome

186589.description:
Elna, the adopted daughter of a baron, lives in the Wizrain Kingdom and endures constant abuse from her elder stepsister. But one fateful day, it all comes rushing back to her. In a past life, she was the famed dragon Elnarfia who protected the nation and longed to be human! Soon, a kingdom-wide search for the girl who is Elnarfia’s reincarnation brings Elna face-to-face with a dear friend from her previous life: the legendary hero, now reborn as the king of Wizrain. But can the two of them rekindle their old bonds, or will they have to start from square one in this new life…?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Tale of the Wizrain Kingdom: The Nation’s Dragon Guardian Is Reborn as a Downtrodden Young Lady
title.native: ウィズレイン王国物語 ～虐げられた少女は前世、国を守った竜でした～
title.romaji: Wizrain Oukoku Monogatari: Shiitagerareta Shoujo wa Zense, Kuni wo Mamotta Ryuu Deshita

186591.description:
In this world of humans and monsters, the Sword God has imparted his power unto humans to defend themselves. To the sword dancers, he gave a part of his spirit essence, and to the sheath maidens, he bestowed a part of his divine power. For generations, they have combined their powers to fight the monsters of the land, revered by the people.

Saki comes from a long line of sheath maidens. Although she's the eldest daughter, she doesn't possess any sheath maiden powers. Compared to her younger sister, who showed talent from a young age, Saki is looked down upon by everyone. Yet, she endures with a smile, holding fast to the words of her grandmother, the only person who ever showed her kindness.

Set up by her sister, Saki is blamed when monsters attack the village. Amid the chaos, just as she's about to meet her fate, Saki is saved by none other than Suguru, known as the strongest sword dancer. The wheels of fate begin to turn with this fateful encounter!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Marriage Vows of the Sword and Sheath: The Useless Priestess Is Adored by the Most Powerful Sword God
title.native: 鞘と刀の契り婚 ～無能な巫女は最強の刀神に溺愛される～
title.romaji: Saya to Katana no Chigiri Kon: Munou na Miko wa Saikyou no Toujin ni Dekiai Sareru

186594.description: Note: Chapters 2-14 were broken into two parts during the original serialization.

title.native: 白魔女さんとの辺境ぐらし　～最強の魔女はのんびり暮らしたい～
title.romaji: Shiromajo-san to no Henkyougurashi: Saikyou no Majo wa Nonbiri Kurashitai

title.native: にじいろキャンパスライフ（仮）

186599.description: Special manga drawn for the Blu-Ray release of the anime Onii-chan wa Oshimai!.
synonyms: Onii-chan Is Done For! Blu-Ray Box Add-in Comic

title.native: お兄ちゃんはおしまい！描き下ろしコミック
title.romaji: Onii-chan wa Oshimai! Kaki Oroshi Comic

186600.description:
Best friends for 17 years, Yeoreum and Noeul always kept things platonic—despite Noeul’s not-so-secret crush. But one impulsive birthday wish crosses a line they can’t uncross. Now Noeul’s acting like nothing happened, while Yeoreum is slowly losing it. Can their friendship survive the fallout, or is this the summer that changes everything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

186601.description:
"I wish I could share my sleepiness with you, Oz-san."

Oz, a designer who has insomnia, secretly admires Amamiya, a kouhai in the general affairs department. Oz admires the way he can quickly turn down a drinking session he doesn't feel like attending, and the way he takes a nap for exactly 15 minutes during his lunch break. Oz, who has a tendency to overthink things and is unable to get along easily with others, looks at him with envy.

On his way home one day, Amamiya invites him out for a drink, and fueled with alcohol, Oz grumbles about his insomnia problems. Afterwards, he decides to let a drunk Amamiya stay at his house. There, Amamiya proposes "co-sleeping" as a solution to Oz's insomnia, and...!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: スリープレス・ビューティー

186602.description:
A slice-of-life about a grandma who had been captivated by 2D characters and became an otaku even after turning 80, and her grandson who kindly watches over while trying to keep a straight face!

A host and a high school student are also involved, are they going to show off their otaku power...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

186604.description:
It is said that Liefes are only capable of conjuring the most difficult and least useful of spells... but that won’t stop Yui from doing what she loves! Despite being born a Liefe, Yui adores magic and learning all she can about it no matter the challenge. The more difficult spells, the better! If only her noble father approved. Deemed a failure to the family name, young Yui and her mother are banished from their own home... but she won’t let that stop her either! After years of struggle and devotion to her studies, Yui is accepted into one of the most prestigious magic academies in the kingdom. Here she will learn from the best magical practitioners in the world—if she can survive amongst all the pompous nobles with more bluster than brains. Constantly ridiculed and undermined by her privileged peers for being a Liefe, will Yui be able to study in peace and prove them wrong? And what ancient mysteries will her research uncover? That is, if the academy doesn’t stop her first...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Blessing of Liefe: Leave This Magical Letdown Alone!
title.native: リーフェの祝福～無属性魔法しか使えない落ちこぼれとしてほっといてください～
title.romaji: Liefe no Shukufuku: Muzokusei Mahoushika Tsukaenai Ochikobore toshite Hottoite Kudasai

186606.description:
The door of fate now opens... Piano prodigy Ichiro Yaso left the world of classical music after an incident at a competition. He vowed to never play the piano again, but now that he has a mentor claiming to be Beethoven, it may be time for his redemption!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes the one-shots "LIFE LIAR FROM HELL" and "Violin-hime (バイオリン姫)".

186607.description:
After their battle with vampires and recovering from the aftermath, Keith and First are moving forward. Keith has been appointed chairman of his family’s company, and First is still working as an agent. Amid it all, they’ve finally acknowledged their love for each other. How will they manage to navigate their new status, and alone time, while dealing with family and obligations?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: デイズ(D:AZE)〜二人のエージェント〜

186608.description:
A story about how I conveyed my feelings to her through a restricted caller number. A rustic yet fresh 2000s era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

186609.description:
1. Ganpanstar (간판스타) 1986
2. Saebyeokgil (새벽길) 1988
3. Mindeulle (민들레) 1987
4. Kim Jong Pal-ssi Gajeong-sosa (김종팔 씨 가정 소사) 1989
5. Seongjil Sunan (성질 수난) 1986
6. Woonsu Joh-eun Nal (운수 좋은 날) 1986
7. Seungbu (승부) 1986

186610.description:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she’s determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Male Leads Trapped in My House
うちに閉じ込められた男主人公たち

title.english: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads

186611.description:
A guy who can’t say no to other people’s requests helps out two hot girls, and they repay him for his kindness… In a naughty way of course!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Lending a Hand for Some Holes
title.native: まんこ貸してくれる先輩

186612.description: England in the Age of Discovery in the 16th century. The twins Olivier Lee and Errol Lee were burdened with the legend of the Golden Land and the fate of their home country. While being involved in a conflict between the state and religion, the two confront the conspiracy.

title.native: おもしろがり屋でいきましょう
生徒と恋はできません！

186615.description:
Little Hiroshi, so embarrassed about the hand-knitted wool pants his grandmother forces him to wear. Sweet Mari, so jealous about her baby sister. Cute Sachiko, so worried about the iron she forgot to turn off before leaving on a family trip. Normal human feelings, understandable mistakes—leading to horrific disaster and scarring regret. If you assume childhood is golden for everyone, you’re wrong…DEAD wrong!

(Source: Living the Line)

1. Whose Child is Mariko? (マリはだれの子)
2. Wool Overalls (毛糸のズボン)
3. Lady Otsuta (おつたさま)
4. Shukudai (宿題)
5. The Ribbon (ひも)
6. Hide and Seek (かくれんぼ)
7. Revenge (復讐)
8. Death of a Bum (こじきの死)
9. Our First Family Trip (はじめての家族旅行)
10. Mother's Necklace (首かざり)
11. Rainy Days (雨)
12. Cheyenne no Oowashi (シャイアンの大わし)
13. Bloody Diary Pages (血ぞめの日記が空を舞う)
14. The Snake God (へび神さま)

Note: the English edition does not include Shukudai and Cheyenne no Oowashi.

title.native: 毛糸のズボン ──直野祥子トラウマ少女漫画全集
title.romaji: Keito no Zubon: Naono Yoshiko Trauma Shoujo Manga Zenshuu

186616.description:
Yazu, a college student who works part-time at a supermarket, is asked by Suzuki, a female co-worker, to read a book for her. Her true identity is a great wizard who has been transported to this world, and the book turns out to be the "true self" hidden deep within each person's heart written out. Suzuki, who is unable to read books due to a curse from her reincarnation, tries to regain her magical powers and return to her original world, by having Yazu read the books for her.

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

186617.description: In 1888, a young client, Mary Morstan, arrives at Holmes's and asks him for help. Watson falls under the spell of the young woman who explains her problem: her father, a navigator in the Indies, died about ten years earlier. However, she has been receiving, for six years, and on a regular basis, pearls of great value. And that same day she receives a letter. An anonymous person asks her to come to an appointment. Holmes agrees to help her and, supported by Watson, accompanies Mary to the said appointment. They discover on the spot that the anonymous person is the son of a former friend and colleague of Captain Morstan. The latter reveals that their fathers had discovered a treasure of five hundred thousand pounds, but that neither the treasure nor the jewels were shared with Morstan's daughter. The man finally explains that his brother discovered the chest yesterday, hidden in their house. But when they arrive at the scene, they find the brother dead and the chest missing. Holmes and Watson then begin a dangerous journey that will lead them to a crazy chase on the Thames...

186622.description: It's a normal meal, but it's special if you're together. Wasuke, a beastman who picked up a lonely "humanoid" girl, tried to cook human food for her...? A heartfelt story that connects bonds and depicts a fluffy everyday life!

title.native: ケモ耳少女の幸せごはん
ふたなりエルフ女戦士オナホ化本
title.romaji: Futanari Elf Onna Senshi Onaho-ka Hon

186624.description:
The Hunters League is a sport where only those with supernatural powers may compete, promising fame, glory, and incredible prizes. Changhyeon Lee had it all, but faces an abrupt downfall during his slump. Cast aside by even his own team, his world crumbles… but fate deals him an unexpected hand when a fatal encounter with a 10-ton truck ends his life, only to send him back in time to the day he discovered his powers. Armed with a second chance, Changhyeon is determined to reclaim and transcend his former glory in the Hunters League.

(Source: WEBTOON)

186625.description:
Princess Celeste has endured a life of torment under her half-brother Raf's oppressive rule. Just as she loses all hope, an unexpected opportunity for marriage appears. Batizo, the fierce emperor of the Kelenev Empire, and his enigmatic aide, Terkan, enter her life, offering a chance to escape. As Celeste finds herself caught between Batizo's wild intensity and Terkan's dark allure, a complex web of romance, jealousy, and power begins to unfold. Will Celeste navigate her way to freedom and love, or will she be ensnared by the dangerous passions that surround her?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: When the Mad Emperor Embraces Me
When the Crazy Emperor Embraces Me

title.english: When the Mad Emperor Holds Me

synonyms: エンジ傑作選 SM劇画セレクション
エンジ傑作選2 誰にも言えない人妻の性生活

186628.description:
In a bid to save the broadcasting club from disbandment, protagonist Yuuto Shimoda is tasked with reading "Rashomon" for the upcoming reading contest. But he feels somehow detached from the assignment. That is, until he encounters a girl in the broadcast room at school whose acting prowess eerily evokes the old woman from "Rashomon."

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: In Pursuit of the Commoner's Fate
title.native: 下人の行方を追いかけて

186629.description:
Rajan, a young man from an impoverished mountain region, arrives in the royal capital and saves a girl named Amrita from a sudden attack. Amrita is a seer who guides the nation using a divination art known as "Mido." Helpless to save the citizens suffering under the palace's tyrannical rule, she sees the makings of a true king in Rajan, who also happens to be a descendant of the former dynasty. However, her powers simultaneously reveal a tragic fate awaiting him...

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

186630.description: Rokurou Ogaki's new series serialized in Kurage Bunch Kai.

title.native: 徳川埋蔵金はアメリカにござる
title.romaji: Tokugawa Maizoukin wa America ni Gozaru

186632.description:
Sohyun knows all about the grind. She's dedicated herself to crawling up the corporate ladder by any means necessary, but a girl's got to blow off steam sometimes! Speaks fly when Sohyun meets a handsome stranger during after work drinks, and their resulting one-night stand scratches an itch. But will it remain just one night?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: イケないことはやめられない

186633.description:
As the captain of Sunyu High's baseball team, Lim Sung is dedicated to bringing the team victory. That's why he wants to recruit a talented batter named Nam Heedo, but Heedo vehemently refuses his offer. Why? Because he can't stand the smell of people! But much to his surprise, Sung smells different to him. So to get Heedo on the team, Sung agrees to Heedo's innocent yet stimulating demands. However, how long can they keep their special arrangement a secret from the rest of the team?

(Source: Tapas)

186636.description:
In a land where humans and monsters destroy each other, a young boy searches for the key to peace.

(Source: VIZ Media)

186638.description:
After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession..!
Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"?

A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a Yandere.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: When I Reincarnated as a Chubby Villainess, For Some Reason, I'm Being Relentlessly Pursued by the Final Boss Prince!
Odebu Akujo ni Tensei Shitara, Naze ka Rasubosu Ouji-sama ni Shuuchaku Sareteimasu

title.english: The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me
title.native: おデブ悪女に転生したら、なぜかラスボス王子様に執着されています
title.romaji: Odebu Akujo ni Tensei Shitara, Naze ka Last Boss Ouji-sama ni Shuuchaku Sareteimasu

title.native: 悪役令嬢に転生したので、最強美少年を育て上げて生き延びようとしたら執着されました
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita node, Saikyou Bishounen wo Sodate Agete Ikinobiyou to Shitara Shuuchaku Saremashita

186640.description:
A collection of short stories.
1. Kareshi no Kyokon ga Hairanai (彼氏の巨根がはいらないっ)
2. Stalker to Kekkon Suru (ストーカーと結婚するっ！)
3. Nibui no wa Docchi? (にぶいのはどっち？)
4. Sono Ato no Youtarou-san to Haruka-chan (その後の陽太郎さんと春歌ちゃん)
synonyms: ストーカーと結婚するっ！
その後の陽太郎さんと春歌ちゃん
Sono Ato no Youtarou-san to Haruka-chan

title.native: 彼氏の巨根がはいらないっ

186641.description:
An original fantasy setting ShotaOne (younger guy x older girl) story about a politically arranged marriage between a boy king and his older bride.

Henri became king at a young age, and the chancellor's daughter Charlotte became his queen. Familial love should be what binds them together, but... Henri has other things in mind.

The story of an older wife who is totally at the mercy of her younger husband.

(Source: DLsite)
synonyms: 少年王と年上王妃シリーズ
Shounen Ou to Toshiue Ouhi Series

title.english: The Boy King and His Older Queen

186642.description:
Not knowing the true intentions of Kurokawa, Shiraishi spends his days kept in suspense. Thinking that he is being trifled with like the other people around her, Shiraishi is hesitant about whether to express his true feelings for her or not.

On the other hand, Kurokawa has a dark past...

(Source: DLsite)

186643.description:
Waka Ichimiya is a high school girl without much of a social life, and she's worried that she is slowly becoming a total outcast. She secretly longs to be more like Shuuichi Yanagi, the cool boy who is always surrounded by a crowd, but she can only look at him from afar… But one day, while leaving school, she helps out Yanagi-kun's younger brother Haruka without knowing who he was, and it's the start of an unexpected relationship!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

186644.description:
Dismissed as incompetent and neglected by her family, the Duke’s daughter, Elsha, is suddenly ordered to marry the infamous Archduke Iceberg—a war hero feared for his ruthless reputation. Rather than despair, she seizes this chance for a fresh start. But upon arriving at his manor, she finds the Archduke missing and is instead met by his wary adopted sons, Wilbert and Hugh—who had no idea their father was remarrying. With an absent husband, distrustful stepchildren, and a manor full of secrets, can Elsha carve out a place for herself and find happiness at last?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: 无能继母备受家族宠爱!
I'm a Worthless Stepmother, But I Love My Family Madly!
A Madrasta Sem Dons é o Coração da Família

title.native: 無能な継母ですが、家族の溺愛が止まりません!
title.romaji: Munou na Mamahaha desu ga, Kazoku no Dekiai ga Tomarimasen!

186645.description:
After years of training, Kim Ryeo-Dam finally made his idol debut. Though not the most popular member of his group, he had his own reason for staying: a quiet, persistent crush on his teammate, Cha Jin-Won. One night, alone at home, Ryeo-Dam stumbled upon a spicy fanfic featuring himself and Jin-Won. The story stirred something in him, and he slipped into the bathroom for a moment of release. But just as he emerged, flustered and breathless, he came face to face with Jin-Won, who had returned early and seen everything. Jin-Won didn’t get angry. Instead, he teased, his voice laced with curiosity and something unreadable. Ryeo-Dam’s mind raced to recover, but before he could stop himself, the words tumbled out.

“What if we tried it... for real?”

Regret hit him the second the words left his mouth. But Jin-Won didn’t laugh or step back. He simply leaned in and pressed a soft kiss to Ryeo-Dam’s cheek. And what brushed against Ryeo-Dam’s thigh wasn’t just Jin-Won’s leg. He was hard.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.
synonyms: Ich habe XX durch Fanfiction gelernt
ผมเรียนเรื่อง XX มาจากแฟนฟิก
ファンフィクでXXを勉強しました!!～アイドル同士の恋愛関係～

186648.description:
Yeon finds herself as an extra in her own novel. To make the most out of the bizarre event, she goes on a quest to find her handsome male lead Chang. However, who she finds is none other than the younger, frail version of the antagonist Bi. Yeon finds that the "antagonist" Bi is being pushed through the narrative of a villain -- can she stay by his side through it all?

(Source: WEBTOON)

186649.description:
"No, I refuse to die this time!"

Juliet is on a mission to find that one happy ending in the loop of tragedies woven into the very fabric of her character and the world around her. From swords to tomatoes, everything in this universe seems to be a death trap designed to create the perfect Shakespearean tragedy. Only her beloved cousin, Tybalt, comes to her aid upon noticing the time loops. Juliet wants her universe back, and Tybalt wants the real Juliet back. And now, they must work together for Juliet to find her true love in Romeo so they can both get what they want…

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

186651.description:
Ijika, a prophet, uses his abilities to make money with his brother day after day. While his brother rejoices in the "offering" from various clients, Ijika has something else on his mind... If you had the power to see the future, how would you use it?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186652.description:
In their daily battle to protect the Earth from alien threats, Nico and Jubei encounter a bizarre extraterrestrial visitor!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186653.description:
Yamashita always sneaks in some sketching in her notebook during class. One day, Miya, who sits in front of her, compliments her drawings. Suddenly, Yamashita's peaceful daily life begins to change...! A heartwarming coming-of-age drama that lovingly portrays the self-consciousness in youth!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 絵が上手いヤマシタさん

186654.description:
I was reborn as Heraise Lorca, the cherished daughter of a viscount and nothing more than an extra in a novel—or so I thought. Life was calm until my father told me to become the playmate of Zenon Lianeric, heir to the house we serve. At first, I thought I would just keep him company, but no, he’s a complete lunatic who plays with magic and uses his friends as toys! Then I found out that he’s terminally ill—and if I can’t save him, I might not survive either!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Save a Time-Limited Young Master

title.english: How to Save the Terminally Ill Young Master
title.native: 余命わずかの公子を救う方法
title.romaji: Yomei Wazuka no Koushi wo Sukuu Houhou

186655.description:
A world that only 'I' know.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes epilogue and review.

186656.description:
Rowan Zhou is an infamous playboy in showbiz and everyone is convinced he doesn't care about anyone... Until a certain video of him went viral. Like a devotee, Rowan's fingers clenched around the woman's thin wrist as his eyes flared with passion. "Please, Yvonne…"

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: クズ社長との偽装結婚

186657.description:
A single chapter promoting the then-upcoming Dragon Ball Super Divers card-based arcade game, starring a young character who enters the world of the game and helps win the battle against Nappa and Vegeta.

(Source: Kanzenshuu)

title.native: ドラゴンボールスーパーダイバーズ

186658.description:
A young character attends a school specifically for Super Divers players in order to become the best in the world.

(Source: Kanzenshuu)

title.native: ドラゴンボールスーパーダイバーズ -レッツ！スーパーダイブ!!
title.romaji: Dragon Ball Super Divers: Let’s Super Dive!!

186660.description:
Diagnosed with terminal cancer... but still... I'm unbreakable.

(Source: Toomics)

186662.description:
This is a story about what happens when a naughty yuri girl is asked to take care of an injured classmate.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

title.native: 恋はシタゴコロにつき

186663.description:
A genius magician created a spell that allows him to reincarnate, while keeping his memories intact. He repeats this reincarnation process 31 times, and now he has become Cyril, a elf boy living in a small village. However, the village is ruled by humans, and the elves are oppressed cruelly. In order to save his childhood friend Lucie, the reborn wizard will stand up to create a new nation where all races can coexist!

(Source: Futabanet, translated)
synonyms: From Elf Reincarnation to Cheat Kingdom Founding Chronicle

title.native: エルフ転生からのチート建国記
title.romaji: Elf Tensei Kara no Cheat Kenkokuki

186664.description:
A self-proclaimed college student, Karen Shiina, suddenly shows up at the door of Ruri Koguchi, an up-and-coming Loli-style manga artist, to apply to become his assistant. But she has her own secrets and an ulterior motive. A workplace romantic comedy between an ero-manga artist and a college girl!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

186665.description: A doujinshi series depicting scenes alluded to in Kinou Nani Tabeta?.
synonyms: Kinou Nani Tabeta? dj - Kenji to Shiro-san
きのう何食べた？ - ケンジとシロさん

186666.description:
Lee Youngsoo has been single her whole life and doesn't believe in love. One day, a dating app pops up on her phone, saying that she has a 98% success rate with a guy. She decides to try it out, but sadly ends up losing the guy to someone else. Furious, she goes to the app's office, where she runs into an old man. As night falls, he turns into the moon god Wolyoung Seon and says that they are destined to be together. Everyone is fated to be with someone, but who knew her someone would be a god?

(Source: Tapas)

186667.description:
After returning from military service, nothing sounds like more of a drag for Wookyung Cha than hanging out with his old friends. In fact, nothing seems to excite Wookyung anymore aside from his new fetish: anonymous, rough sex. Thankfully, a chance encounter at a suspicious bar may just help him find his fill and more...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 臨界点〜歪んでいく二人の関係〜

186668.description:
Sumikawa Haruto, 25, becomes his younger brother's freeloader—!?

Haruto, who is currently a freeloader, is asking a woman for money for her rent. As negotiations hit a deadlock, his younger brother, Asahi, shows up by chance! Originally, Haruto had behaved as the "perfect older brother" in front of his family, and was unable to tell anyone about his current, downtrodden situation. He desperately tries to cover up the situation. However, Asahi follows him to his house and finds out about his current lifestyle...!? The story of the frustrating, mismatched brother love between an obsessive, cool younger brother and a former perfect older brother begins here! What is the true nature of the "complexes" each of them holds?

(Source: Bunendo, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: ダブルコンプレックス

186669.description:
Mariel Peridenver can’t wait to attend the emperor’s birthday party—but not because she cares about the emperor. Her only goal is to confess her love to the man of her dreams, the dashing Sir Resnor, and have her way with him! But when the clock strikes 10, something strange happens: Mariel is seized with uncontrollable desire, making her desperate to jump into bed with someone… anyone! Can Mariel satisfy her lust, shake off this raunchy curse, and still achieve a happy ending with her dream guy?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

186671.description:
Do-Jun, who has never been with a girl, accidentally witnesses an unwanted scene in the projection room and receives a fellatio in exchange for keeping his mouth shut. In fact, she had an untold story about sleeping with several male part-timers… But there’s also a sudden participant! Do-Jun who falls for her the more and more close he gets to her… She, whose emotions aren’t clearly visible, is starting to gravitate towards the affectionate man… And the sudden co who’s trying to take Do-Jun away by dedicating herself to the very beginning for her revenge! Let their passionate romantic battle at the movie theater commence!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

186672.description:
After missing the village bus, Da-Eun sets out on foot to reach her village in the remote mountains. As she stumbles wearily along, her sweaty clothes flapping in the midsummer sun, a man stops his car and offers her a ride…for a price. In the heat of the moment, Da-Eun makes a choice that will take her on the ride of her life.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.
synonyms: おじさん、タクシー代払います
รักครั้งนี้ ขอจ่ายด้วยหัวใจฉัน

186673.description:
When she wakes up as an extra in a fantasy novel, married to a villain and destined to be poisoned to death, Lea knows she must change her fate. Her strategy? Get rid of the booze and men in her harem, soften up her tyrannical emperor husband by being kind and gentle with him, and make him fall in love with her for real! But he’s been trained his whole life not to feel anything at all... Hopefully, that pesky prophecy about an emperor with feelings bringing doom to the empire isn’t true!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Tyrant's Time-Limited Wife

title.english: Living Out My Deadline as the Tyrant's Wife

186674.description:
Being the only wingless princess of Tilmun, Seraphine led a lonely and miserable life among winged royals. After being killed by her own father, she wakes up 500 years later as Lady Seraphine, a young noblewoman infamous for her rare condition and wild behavior. This time, she has wings, but they are draining her mana and killing her. As more secrets surface and people from her past appear, will Seraphine finally find peace? Or will she merely remain a villainess cursed with wings?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Even If I Say I'm Not a Villain Now

186675.description:
During a once-in-a-lifetime ceremony, the young boy, Yuri, receives the trash skill "Life transfer," allowing him to transfer his life force to another person... Crushed by despair after receiving the skill, Yuri encounters a woman who loses her life right in front of him. Wanting to be the one to decide who he gives his life to, he activates "Life Transfer," dying on the spot. It had appeared as though the woman's life was ended rather abruptly, however, the woman turned out to be the daughter of god. As a "thank you" for saving the life of his daughter, god resurrected Yuri, and in addition, gave him the ability to receive double the experience points each month. With the endless amount of experience he gains, Yuri will leisurely walk the path to the world's strongest, collecting endless amounts of skills along the way!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 無限のスキルゲッター!

186676.description:
Yuzaburo married Tsumugi, a fox demon 100 years his senior, in a political marriage that transcended the boundaries of race, between humans and demons. There was no love between the two of them, who registered their marriage as proof of a peace treaty, but... This is the story of a boy and a nine-tailed fox who are entrusted with the mission of "bearing a child" for the sake of peace.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

186677.description:
Adored by her noble family, Saina Devof had a perfect life until one night ruined her societal debut, her family’s honor, and her future in one fell swoop. Determined to fix her mistake, she chooses to marry the man from that night, only to find herself trapped in a nightmare that ended with her lonely death. Then, she woke up. 18 years old again with a second chance at life, Saina swears off marriage for good. But her plans change when he appears:

“I want to be your choice.”

Enter Duke Constantine—the man determined to rewrite her destiny.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: I'll Take That Marriage This Time
title.native: 그 결혼, 이번 생엔 제가 할게요
title.romaji: Geu Gyeolhon, Ibeon Saengen Jega Halgeyo

186678.description:
Rei, a white mage who belongs to an A-rank adventurer party, is expelled from the party as a useless person who cannot move after using Heal once. Only one dagger was handed over. Left alone in the SSS-rank dungeon, Labyrinth of Yggdrasil, he prepares for death... "You're the first human to reach this far." As if being guided by something, Rei meets Norn, a mysterious girl who lives in the lowest level of the dungeon, World Tree! Rei, who obtained infinite magical power, was trained by Norn to survive in this harsh dungeon. "Norn, I..." There was something left unfinished. The boy who has become the strongest returns to earth with only one knife in his hand. The strongest high-fantasy begins here!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: A White Mage Who Was Exiled After Being Handed a Knife in an SSS-Rank Dungeon. Due to the Curse of Yggdrasil, He Overcame His Weak Point, Lack of Magical Power, and Became the Strongest in the World

title.native: SSSランクダンジョンでナイフ一本手渡され追放された白魔導師 ユグドラシルの呪いにより弱点である魔力不足を克服し世界最強へと至る
title.romaji: SSS-Rank Dungeon de Knife Ippon Tewatasare Tsuihou Sareta Shiromadoushi: Yggdrasil no Noroi ni Yori Jakuten de Aru Maryoku Fusoku wo Kokufukushi Sekai Saikyou e to Itaru

186679.description:
If my life is a boring life without anything special, then I'll just create it myself! Hong Seon-hee, who realized that her life has no impact, decides to decide the genre of her life herself. With a sparkling romance! Will Seon-hee, who decided to become the main character herself, be able to live a special life with the male protagonist?

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

186680.description:
Koga is a new employee at SHWD, a company that "disposes" of Dynamis, or anti-human weapons developed in the last war. In a male dominant environment, she is happy to have a fellow female, Sawada, as her training supervisor. Opposite of her masculine appearance, Koga is very feminine at heart, and is just like any other young woman when it comes to romance.

(Source: eManga)

186681.description:
Seung-Yeon is popular for her pretty face, tall stature, and unique aura. she works at a Pc cafe, where she gets cheap self-esteem from the men who show her favour, who are favourable to her. Now in her fourth year, she knows she should be focusing on her studies, but Seung-Yeon can't quit her job at the café easily...

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

186682.description:
I, someone who has an almost pathological hatred of the cold, somehow ended up transmigrating into the body of the Grand Duchess of the North. But of all places, why the freezing North?! Desperate to escape what feels like certain death by freezing, I try to run away, but every single attempt is foiled by the Grand Duke, who relentlessly brings me back.

“Run away as much as you want. I’ll just catch you every single time.”

In the original story, I’m pretty sure this couple was supposed to end on bad terms—so why is he so obsessed with me? I’m telling you, I can’t survive here in this freezing cold! (Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)
synonyms: 北部の大公妃は寒すぎてムリです

title.native: 북부 대공 부인, 추워서 못 하겠습니다
title.romaji: Bukbu Daegong Buin, Chuwoseo Mot Hagetseumnida
Oni wa Kyou mo Ame wo Matsu

186685.description:
Haruka, a high school student living in the countryside near the sea, was supposed to be going about his daily life as usual today. But on his way home from school, he encounters a man with a suspicious looking hood. He has a kitchen knife in his hand and a bucket of... fish? The suspicious atmosphere is overwhelming, but he turns out to be a graduate student from the city who studies marine biology... Despite his flamboyant appearance, he is a serious and gentle man who seems to unexpectedly take a liking to Haruka...? The somewhat lethargic but straightforward world of a high school student begins to sparkle with a summer encounter.

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

186686.description:
1. Dareka ga Mitsumeteru (だれかが見つめてる)
2. Ningyo-tachi no Yoru (形たちの夜)
3. Koori no Requiem (氷のレクイエム)

186687.description:
"Kang Sung-Won" loved me since I was a child and I don't even remember. I'm still too young to talk about love and I'm not sure. Sung-Won always expresses love confidently. Will there be a change with Sung-Won's pheromones? If I only express as omega, then I'll be able to accept everything naturally...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: 僕は君が好きだ〜いつもそばにいる君へ〜

186688.description:
After losing his parents in a tragic car crash, college student Lee Si-Hyuk is left alone to raise his baby brother, Si-Ha. In order to do so, Si-Hyuk decides to follow in his father's footsteps and become a translator. While working to apply for the job, he suddenly finds himself knowledgeable about things he's never learned and starts to gain recognition as a translation prodigy! But even with his mysterious new ability, can Si-Hyuk really balance work and school, all while raising a 3-year-old?

(Source: Tapas)

186689.description:
Chris, the eldest son of a prestigious family that has been bestowed the profession of the sword for generations, is banished from his home after receiving the profession of "Farmer" in the Grace of Heaven ceremony. Amid his despair, he discovers that a special power lies hidden within his unique skill of poison resistance!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Exiled First-Born of the Noble House: Rise to the Top With Ridiculously Haphazard Skills

title.native: 追放された名家の長男 ～馬鹿にされたハズレスキルで最強へと昇り詰める～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Meika no Chounan: Baka ni Sareta Hazure Skill de Saikyou e to Noboritsumeru

186690.description:
As a fellow aspiring saint with healing powers, Belze spent her whole childhood being compared to the ever-so-perfect Diana. So when offered the chance to expose her rival's family for treason, she doesn't think twice... But it all turns out to be a trap that only gets herself and her benevolent sponsor framed and executed! Luckily, she's given a second shot: She wakes up at the age of 5 again, determined to repay her benefactors this time. But turning a new leaf is easier said than done...

(Source: Tapas)

186691.description: After the commercial serialization of Sylph no Hanahime ended with three volumes, the mangaka decided to self-publish a continuation of the story, with the approval of the publisher.

186692.description:
As a young child, Lily was sold into slavery by her own parents, never knowing the meaning of freedom. With a scarred body and soul, she trudged through life, questioning the purpose of her existence. As Lily grappled with her grim fate, Sir Ortiz, the Captain of the Knights, unexpectedly entered her life. His kindness and encouragement breathed hope into Lily's spirit, coaxing her to embrace the concept of living freely, a notion foreign to her battered heart. However, a profound secret cloaked Ortiz—he was not merely human, but also half-beast, a kind universally hunted across the country. Their paths, destined never to intersect in the ordinary course of life, have woven together in an extraordinary tapestry of fate. The half-beast and the slave girl have chosen each other, against all odds. But what destiny lies in wait for them?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: Tes yeux sont aussi jolis que le ciel

title.native: 奴隷少女は白銀の龍に溺愛されて
title.romaji: Dorei Shoujo wa Shirogane no Ryuu ni Dekiaisarete

186693.description:
Nagisa Haruki’s parents were killed in a car accident, leaving him adopted into the Nagisa family, but Haruki has a dark past that none of them knows.

As it turns out, Haruki’s father was a highly skilled trainer within a prostitution ring called Under Eden, and now he obtains the power to enslave the people taking him in. Both Natsume Sayoko and Fuyuno Reiko, become his targets, as he uses the strange drugs he obtains from his connection to Under Eden's Paradise and posts images online on their website.

The sister of Reiko, Ayase Ryoko which works for Section Eight, a special police department, has investigating strange disappearances in the city and connects it to the case. However, even when she visits Cafe Natsume, she is unaware that her biggest lead is so close to her.

186694.description:
Hardworking, diligent, and serious college student Yuu can do anything with ease—which causes most guys to find her far too intimidating. Longing to become someone’s "number one," she wonders if she’ll have to change who she is to find love. That’s when she meets Yang, an attractive and friendly Chinese exchange student. But looks can be deceiving, as she discovers his life-altering secret! What began as a "professional" arrangement between a headstrong girl and puppy-like boy blossoms into a heart-pounding pure romance!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Serialization on MangaUP! ended with chapter 15 (vol. 3), but the mangaka is looking for another publisher to continue publication.
synonyms: 양 선배는 혼자서 살아갈 수 없어

title.native: ヤン先輩はひとりで生きていけない

186695.description: Tenshi no Harawata is a manga better known in America for its B-movie adaptions. The oppressively exploitative manga deals with violent rape and murder.

186696.description:
Movie otaku Meguru Kanae had potential love interests in elementary, junior high, and high school, but he never made a move due to his lack of experience in love. Disillusioned by his past experience, he vows to devote all his energy to the Movie Club at university and forgo romance altogether. However, his resolution is short-lived, as he falls in love with Sora Ootsuka as soon as he walks into Movie Club. This is the start of a romantic comedy that will sweep all the love flags away!

(Source: Magapoke, translated)

(Source: Lezhin US)

186772.description:
Gyo-ha and Jun-oh were once each other’s first love, but they eventually broke up due to sexual incompatibility. Ten years later, Gyo-ha, now an investment professional searching for fresh opportunities, stumbles upon a dating app called “AM2”—and unexpectedly reconnects with Jun-oh. Wanting more than just nostalgia, Gyo-ha proposes a casual fling—an offer Jun-oh eagerly accepts. However, as Jun-oh's feelings grow stronger, he begins to fear that history might repeat itself, and that his affection will only push Gyo-ha further away. Caught between nostalgia and desire, can they truly keep things casual, or will their unresolved emotions threaten to change everything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.

186773.description:
Despite her impressive qualifications and a degree from a prestigious university, Kang Yoo-Na is struggling to find a job. Frustrated after sending out countless resumes, she decided to indulge herself (if you know what I mean). But as she finished, she found a strange man staring back at her. The man, Kyle, turned out to be the CEO of a start-up in the underworld, and Yoo-Na unexpectedly ended up working there on a short-term contract. On her first day, Yoo-Na and Kyle encountered each other at a mysterious hot spring in Ulcheon Mountain, deep in the heart of Hell...

(Source: Lezhin US)

One morning in my second year of marriage, it dawned on me that my reserved husband never loved me, and while reeling from the shocking realization, on that same day, I lost my life in an accident… That is what Lady Amelia Plowright remembers from her previous life. When she attends her first soirée, a silver-haired handsome man suddenly grabs her arm, but upon closer inspection, she realizes it is actually her husband from her past life?! She wanted to stay far away from him in this life, but her husband, who was expressionless and reticent in his previous life, has now transformed into an extremely doting person in this life?!

(Source: K Manga)

186777.description:
The first time Lu Jingyan met Sheng Xian was at a bar, she had no signal on her mobile phone, so she asked him to borrow the internet, and asked him what was his hotspot password? Sheng Xian told her, "It's your birth date." Lu Jingyan felt that Sheng Xian must like her to be using her birthday as a password, so she began to try to seduce Sheng Xian overtly and secretly. It wasn't until half a year later that she accidentally discovered that Sheng Xian's WiFi hotspot password was actually…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

186778.description: Ryuichi, a 44-year-old single father, gets into a traffic accident while protecting his high school daughter Mizuho, ​​who ran away from home after an argument. After losing consciousness and accepting his death, he finds himself in the body of a young man he had never seen before. While panicking, he finds a girl who looks exactly like Mizuho when she was a child, and as he sorts out the situation, it seems that he has been reincarnated as the father of the game's villainess…!?

186779.description:
After her sudden death at the hands of an assassin, the former granddaughter of a yakuza boss reincarnates in an otome game as the heroine. The game is, of course, set in the time of early European mafia (but with magic), specifically a kingdom where the royal family is supported behind the scenes by five major gangsters!

A dangerous love game between a former yakuza heiress and her villain fiancé begins!

(Source: TO Books, translated)
synonyms: Akutou Ikka no Manamusume, Tenseisaki mo Otome Game no Gokudou Reijoudeshita.: Saijoukyuu Ranku no Akuyaku-sama, sono Dekiai wa Fuyoudesu!

186780.description:
After 25 years, you think you’d know almost everything about your best friend. But Jeong-U has been keeping a secret or two from Yi-Seo for a while now... One, he has been harboring a crush on her for years, and two, he has been blessed with a particular talent that is hard to measure…in more ways than one! But when the two end up moving in together, everything will be revealed…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

186781.description:
In this spin-off of Dulce Report, Aoi Kiyose, aka Yukari Kuroki, is anxious about her school life because she is a futanari. Her memory is a bit fuzzy, but she remembers her transformation occurred while having sex with Momoe in the student council room.

(Source: DLSite, translated)

title.romaji: Futanari Nanode Gakkou Seikatsu Ga Fuan Desu

186782.description:
Aim to become the “hero” of your life!

Sadayoshi Tanabe and Michiyuki Nakayama, a clumsy car salesman, have never got along ever since childhood. But their destiny changes drastically when they become heroes after fighting off a robbery. Although they were sincere and truthful, they are fired from their jobs and somehow end up working together to build a new company.

Will the two be able to achieve “true success”?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

186783.description:
A high school boy looking for a place to live finds a cheap room for rent in a "notorious property." It is haunted by the ghost of a lady knight!

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

186784.description:
Desperate for his father’s love, Un-Hyuk agrees to a suspicious proposal: spend two years in a rural village acting as a protective charm, and in return, inherit the family business. In the village, he encounters Tae-Moon, a mysterious young man rumored to be possessed by a ghost. Despite being ostracized by the villagers, Tae-Moon tirelessly seeks their approval. Haunted by memories of his own painful past, Un-Hyuk finds himself drawn to Tae-Moon’s plight and proposes a risky plan—one that could change both their fates and break the curse.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

186785.description:
Koh Eun-Dan, once an Ex-Idol, now working as a photoshoot assistant, is helping out with top model Won-Hae’s cover shoot. The atmosphere heats up as Eun-Dan is asked to help with grooming Won-Hae’s more private areas. Little does he know, Won-Hae’s motives aren’t purely business-related, as he was one of Eun-Dan’s biggest fans back in his idol days…

(Source: Lezhin US)

186788.description:
At the age of 6, Ed, a boy suddenly recalls that he is a reincarnated individual from modern Japan. However, his current life unfolds in the slums of another world!
Struggling with a poverty-stricken existence in his daily life, he shares his living space with and eats with his childhood friend, a girl named Miinya. Their daily fare consists mainly of 'boiled beans.' Ed, drawing upon his knowledge from modern Japan, discovers edible wild plants and leaves suitable for making tea to improve their dietary situation.
In pursuit of a slow life, Ed's life of gathering and hunting begins!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Rumors have been going around about how to summon a sex demon. This is a peek into the nights of two girls who decided to try the ritual themselves...

186812.description:
A futanari girl gets teased by a pretty young boy. No reversals!

Fumino is an alpha (futanari)... but a medical report shows her alpha genes are impotent... Unable to accept the reality that she cannot impregnate omegas... Fumino happens upon an omega male, Kaoru, that is on the verge of entering heat.

She immediately recognizes him as her destiny... But no sooner than that does this supposedly omega male pin her down...

Wait a second, isn't Fumino the alpha here!?

(Source: DLsite)

Should you sell dreams? Buy dreams? Or...?

Oiran (courtesan), the business of selling dreams.
Though he reigns at the top of his courtesan profession, Awabeni leads a boring life. While gazing at the fleeting yet beautiful...and hateful cherry blossoms blooming before his eyes, a mysterious person named "Yazome" appears.
Who on earth is she?

(Source: DLsite)

186814.description:
Asami and her little brother Haruto live together by themselves.
As of late, Asami has been concerned by recurring dreams of her having sex with her brother Haruto.
She and is burdened by feelings of guilt and shame... That perhaps deep down she harbors indecent feelings for him.
All the while, Haruto quietly observes his sister... ------

186815.description:
Yuzuru didn't expect to see B the incubus again, but he agrees to invite her over to his house. While he shows her his "human" side, he's still a sex demon at heart.

186817.description:
While B the incubus is showing Yuzuru more attention, she can’t shake the feeling that he’s only interested in her for her body.

186818.description:
Due to an injury Fumika's mother has become overprotective and sees her to and from school everyday. Today, as per usual, she waits in the science room for her mother to come pick her up. The teacher there is a impartial fellow that doesn't make a fuss about her using her smartphone.

(Source: dlsite, translated)

186819.description:
Yuzuru continues his relationship with B, the whore he summoned in.She's worried that B might end the relationship because of something he said. They take secret evening walks together, he teaches her how to have sex with him as an adult, and they do things behind the family's back while taking showers...

(Source: dlsite, translated)

186820.description:
Rio invokes the whore “B” as a joke spell with her friends. She compares him to her ex-boyfriend, Iida, which may have irked Rio, but she tries to get him to admit that she is the better sex partner. Rio's response was, “Hey, that's enough, okay? Are you sorry?” Rio's body is being taught to enjoy the pleasures of sex, despite her feelings of rebellion against B's words and actions....

(Source: dlsite, translated)

They have not been able to see each other for a while since the start of summer vacation. Perhaps to make up for the time they spent not touching each other, Yuzuru is invited by B to stay at his room.

186826.description:
The dead no longer stay dead. They rise—not as monsters, but as aimless wanderers—plunging the world into chaos. Hope of immortality fades as disasters push humanity to the brink of extinction. Amidst the ruin, Pyo Guwon walks against the tide of fleeing survivors. On his path, he finds Heo Jinwoo, left for dead after an attack. Instead of passing by, Pyo offers a hand, posing a single question: "How does it feel to survive hell?" With that, he leads Jinwoo to a village where death holds no meaning—but in a world that refuses to let go of the past, survival is never that simple.

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: The Hounds of Sisyphus〜救いの先にあるもの〜

186828.description:
The return of the sensitive, blushing girlfriend! ♪ They're hooked on having sex in secret! ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2020-09

186830.description:
Lord Ranga had risen from a lowly goblin to become one of the Four Heavenly Kings of the demon realm through his efforts, but he was despised by the other Heavenly Kings as the “weakest of the Four." On the day when the human adventurers attacked the demon realm, Ranga was betrayed and lost his life in a conspiracy. Ranga is reborn as a human, but with the memories of his previous life still intact, and tries to lead a peaceful life unlike that of his war-torn past. However, he is confronted by Amira, his former confidant, as well as the enemy who wronged him...

Will his wish for peace come true...?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.native: 四天王最弱だった俺。転生したので平穏な生活を望む
title.romaji: Shitennou Saijaku datta Ore. Tensei Shita node Heion na Seikatsu wo Nozomu

186831.description: A school romance about a popular girl who secretly writes fantasy love stories—and the boy who discovers her hidden passion.

186838.description:
There is a place rumored to grant any wish. Run by Kazumi, a fortune teller with the ability to see the future, the office is always bustling with visitors. One day, a high school girl comes in with a request—she's in love with her teacher. With Kazumi’s help, she gets a glimpse of the future and manages to make her love mutual. But as time goes on, her desires start to spiral out of control... The story follows Kazumi as she helps fulfill people's wishes, for better or worse.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

186839.description:
A cohabitation rom-com between a refined young lady and a bold younger boy.

After losing her parents, Riko moves in with her cousin Masami, finding comfort in living with the man she’s long admired. But she soon clashes with Asagi, a cocky, outspoken younger boy also staying there. Though he irritates her, his honesty starts to shake her heart…
synonyms: a rose by any other smell would smell as sweet

186840.description:
A collection of Misao Inagaki's early oneshots from the Horror M magazine, known for extremely high quality horror manga and for its splatter horror series.

Volume 1: Jisatsu-bu (自殺部)
Jitsue is a second-year student who has just transferred to a new junior high. She wants to make friends as soon as possible, so she's glad when her classmate Chiaki invites Jitsue to come visit her club activity. But what happens when Jitsue finds out that the club is a “Suicide Club” that selects one person to commit suicide each month...!

Volume 2: Kubitori Kanban (首取り看板)
In addition to the title story, this horror anthology is filled with hair-raising scenes of terror! A dark story about Valentine's Day, and a gory incident at a school...?

Volume 3: Nounai Chiryou: Brain Cure (脳内治療ブレーン・キュア)
Shin Asakusa, a doctor who practices "brain cure" by entering directly into the brains of his patients to treat their psychological issues at the root of the problem. What is the fate of Shin and his patients who are lost in the maze of their brains?

title.native: 稲垣みさおホラーM選集

186841.description:
Rolicia Roba’s world is turned upside down when her mother tragically passes away. And not only does her long-lost father come to fetch her, but he turns out to be the renowned Count Roward. Thrust into noble society as an illegitimate child, Rolicia is determined to secure her own future without relying on her newfound father. But her cunning stepmother and selfish half-sister are standing stubbornly in her path… and so is Lockhart Caidel, the wartime savior of the second crown prince. With razor-sharp wit and a will of steel, Rolicia refuses to go down—or fall in love—without a fight!

(Source: Tappytoon)

186843.description: A slow-paced love story set in Kyoto, featuring a camera-loving girl and the most visually stunning guy.

186844.description:
A reader is magically transported into a BL novel called The Night of Hwangseong. She now inhabits the body of Lobelia Flore, the daughter of a noble family suffering from a rare illness. Lobelia discovers that the only way to avoid a painful death is to remain in close physical contact with Edric Dencart, the young, beautiful, and sickly duke. To do this, Lobelia disguises herself as a man named “Lobel” and commits herself to becoming the Duke of Dencart’s most trusted manservant.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: お坊っちゃまに執着して生き残ります

Rebel fangs defy order, price paid with raging fire.

186846.description:
Cai Tongan finally went to have her wisdom tooth extracted when the pain became intolerable. That was when she met the kind and beautiful dentist Xie Ruanqing. And then she found out that Xie Ruanqing was the senior girl she had a crush on in college…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
