186847.description:
Alicia Oslind is known as “The Frozen Lady.” She is seen as a villainess among the aristocrats because of her harsh words and attitude that make people think the worst of her. In truth, she just has trouble being honest with her feelings… However, there is one person that she allows herself to befriend. The only one she allows into her heart is a boy named Gray, who works as a manservant in the mansion.

You are the only one who understands me!

Alicia becomes completely devoted to Gray, spoiling him to the hilt, at mealtimes, in the bathroom, and before bed! Because the lady is an aristocrat and Gray is a commoner, he must endure this doting love! An intense fantasy love comedy!

(Source: Super Hero Comics, translated)

186849.description:
A company drone who died from overworking was reincarnated as Sawadi, the third son of a merchant in a different world. His specialty is restoration magic and support magic. He used his cheat skills to come up with a new model of business. He decided to use his restoration magic to cure cheap slaves and make them earn money.

Although his earnings are steadily increasing, he also has to suffer its consequence of his work load also getting increased... Will Sawadi ever be able to live leisurely without working? The beginning of this lazy and relaxing fantasy, is starting here!"

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

synonyms: ブラック　キャット

186862.description:
The Demon who commits endless acts of tyranny, Takeomi the Fallen. Shoutarou Murata, the Ronin who set out to subjugate him was actually Takeomi's son. Along his journey, an unknown vengeful spirit appears before Shoutarou, insisting that its help is essential to defeat the Fallen, but...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186864.description:
Doo-San and Tae-San were inseparable as teens, just two boys, side-by-side at their favorite arcade. Now reunited as adults, nothing’s changed…and yet everything has. Their bond is as tight as ever, but lately, the air between them crackles with something more. Doo-San can’t stop overthinking every glance, every brush of skin, every heartbeat. Just when he thinks he can keep burying those feelings, someone new shows up, ready to drive a wedge right through whatever’s been building between them. Unless Doo-San can work up the courage to face his own feelings, that is...

(Source: Lezhin US)

186865.description:
Reincarnation Life Cast by Dice, aka "ReLife," is a mobile game that I transmigrated into. The objective is to help the main characters save the world from the evil demon king, with each character classified by how crucial they are to the plot. I awoke in the body of Alyssa G. Dravein, a side character who dies by her father's hand when she turns nine years old. But, my dad seems to love me so much--where did it all go wrong? Can I change my fate and live to see ten?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Extra but the Duke's Only Daughter

title.english: An Extra, Yet the Duke's Only Daughter

186866.description:
The ill-fated flower seller falls in love with the captive dragon knight──.

In order to save his beloved dragon, who was injured on the battlefield, the hero of the enemy kingdom, Ricardo, offered his own life in exchange. Captured and isolated with no help, yet still not losing the light in his eyes, he caught the attention of a poor flower seller named Suiren, who instantly fell in love with him…

(Source: ABJ, translated)

title.native: ひとりぼっちの花娘は檻の中の竜騎士に恋願う
title.romaji: Hitoribocchi no Hana Musume wa Oni no Naka no Ryuukishi ni Koi Negau

186867.description: Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2025 issue 12.

title.native: グレイキースの魔界語訳録

186868.description:
"You’d keep wearing lingerie for me if I did what you asked?"

Yun Hee-Il’s secret fetish is uncovered by his close friend Hyuk, who uses it to tease him and push the boundaries of their relationship. But over time, Hee-Il starts to feel a strange attraction toward Hyuk, the only one who seems to understand his hidden side...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.

186869.description:
One day, Carina, a lady who has been groomed to be queen, suddenly has her engagement annulled by her fiancee, the prince. Now he is sending Carina into exile while standing beside her sister Aurora instead. Exiled to the far north, where demons are said to dwell, Carina ventures out to investigate the identity of a disturbing sound and has a fateful encounter in the snow…? A predatory love fantasy between a lady sworn to revenge and a strange girl seeking love!

(Source: Comic Seasons, translated)

186870.description:
Her crush, the prince of her dreams, turns out to be a childish brat?

(Source: Dessert, translated)

Notes:
- Winner of the Excellence Award in the 55th Dessert Manga Newcomer contest.
- Originally published in Dessert Magazine 2024 Sep. issue.

title.native: 理想じゃなくても君がいい
title.romaji: Risou Janakute mo Kimi ga Ii

186871.description:
Everybody knows Yoo Hajin. Richer than the devil with a personality to match, Hajin is infamous… as the crazy side top of a BL webtoon. Or so he once was, until he reawakens with the new soul of a normal and harmless college student. Farewell, obsessive psycho version of Hajin! It's time for a change of pace, and Hajin decides to start by befriending the original main bottom his fictional counterpart used to torment: Seonwoo. They can be normal friends this time, right? …Right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: It's Me, the Crazy Side Top

synonyms: 승리의 여신: 니케 청춘 버스트! 니케 학원

title.native: 勝利の女神：NIKKE 青春バースト！ニケ学園
title.romaji: Shouri no Megami: NIKKE - Seishun Burst! Nikke Gakuen

186874.description:
Hiro, who was working at a black company, is suddenly reincarnated into another world one day. But what he receives upon coming of age… is a skill that he did not expect! And then he is banished to a remote territory with few citizens…?

(Source: Novema, translated)

title.native: 追放された転生貴族、外れスキルで内政無双: 気ままに領地運営するはずが、スキル『ガチャ』のお陰で最強領地を作り上げてしまったる
title.romaji: Tsuihousareta Tensei Kizoku, Hazure Skill de Naisei Musou: Kimama ni Ryouchi Uneisuru Hazu ga, Sukiru "Gacha" no Okage de Saikyou Ryouchi wo Tsukuriagete Shimattaru

186875.description:
In a previous life, Hiro worked for a black company. In this life, he is the eldest son of a noble family, and he thought he was in a safe and secure position. However, he is banished to a desolate frontier territory with no inhabitants, because the skills he was given did not seem very powerful.

But along the way, Hiro's special skill “Gacha,” is awakened! The situation changes drastically when he draws the Legendary Rare Egg of the Divine Dragon.

An young man in exile will create the most powerful territory in the world!

(Source: Novema, translated)

title.native: 追放された転生貴族、外れスキルで内政無双～気ままに領地運営するはずが、スキル『ガチャ』のお陰で最強領地を作り上げてしまった～
title.romaji: Tsuihousareta Tensei Kizoku, Hazure Skill de Naisei Musou: Kimama ni Ryouchi Uneisuru Hazu ga, Sukiru "Gacha" no Okage de Saikyou Ryouchi wo Tsukuriagete Shimattaru

186877.description:
Ishida and Kimura have been seeing each other for twenty years...but only once a month. They manage their work, and head for a hotel or ryokan where they can relax in a hot spring bath. No one, even their closest friends know about their relationship. This month, they are together again...for the 241st time. They soak themselves in hot bath, treat themselves with good food.

"...Hey. Wanna come closer?"

"Okay."

This relaxing trip is what the mature couple live for.

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: The 241-st Secret Trip to the Hot Springs

title.english: Hot Nights at the Hot Springs, Secret Trip No. 241
title.native: 温泉で秘密のお泊り、241回目
エルフ(巨大)の里に迷いこんだら

186880.description:
All Isaac the beta wants is to live a normal life as a slightly unskilled florist and leave his turbulent past behind. That dream quickly goes out the window, however, when the infamous arms dealer Felix waltzes into his shop and takes a liking to him. It just so happens that Isaac's family needs protection from a mysterious enemy, and luckily, Felix is more than willing to provide it in return for Isaac's body. The more Felix falls for the reserved florist, the more he wants to unlock his many secrets. And as things heat up in the bedroom, Isaac finds it harder to resist the handsome alpha and his powerful pheromones. Meanwhile, the secret about their shared past hangs in the air like a ticking timebomb...

(Source: Tappytoon)

186882.description:
In order to participate in star PD Choi Ji-Hoon’s new entertainment, ‘S Signal,’ a variety of participants from idol actors, sexy BJs, models, yoga instructors, and baeksu gathered at the love house! However, contrary to what was known to the participants, all kinds of conspiracies were planned on the set including sex and voyeurism.

(Source: Anytoon, translated)

title.native: エリートは學び足りない

186887.description:
A boy named Leito is reborn in another world as the youngest son of a farmer with a little memory of his previous life. He tries to play an active role by playing the typical knowledge cheat, but no one takes him seriously because of his lack of education and young age.
On the other hand, even when he tries to live a normal life, he is abused and beaten by his family.... On his 7th birthday, when he is given skills and status, he decides to run away from home and live as an adventurer... Reincarnated in another world, but without any cheats! He will get out of every problem with luck and resourcefulness! A new kind of slow and leisurely adventure fantasy begins!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: レイトのゆるーい転生生活

186888.description:
I wish I could redo that “disastrous first night.” I’ve been thinking about it for a long, long time.
When photographer Mibu wakes up, he finds himself in an unknown hot spring inn.

“It’s been a long time.” Tsutsuumi, a classmate whom he had a crush on in college and had drifted apart since their failed first night together is there.. He tells him “I heard you were in a slump, so I brought you to our inn when you were drunk.”
If they could get one more chance to be together. A genius photographer in a slump and his former best friend. The love that has been smoldering for a long time is now starting to move again…

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)
synonyms: The Love Story That Didn't End

title.native: 終われなかった恋の話

186889.description:
A years-long unemployed 'Ju In-Geong', lies to his former classmates at a reunion, claiming he’s a restaurant owner after being provoked by a friend. Determined not to be humiliated, he decides to actually become a real restaurant owner.
Struggling to manage a nearly empty eatery, he unexpectedly receives a mysterious seasoning from a foreign laborer living upstairs. Overnight, his restaurant becomes packed with customers, transforming him into a true restaurant owner.
However, the happiness that seemed endless doesn’t last long, as he soon discovers the shocking truth behind the seasoning…

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: สูตรลับร้านเด็ด

186891.description:
At a college welcome party, Kang Ju-Yeong overhears a juicy rumor about Choi Hyun, a popular student from the Physical Education department—apparently, he accepts professions of love from almost anyone, even strangers. As the drinks flow, the conversation escalates into a daring bet: whoever confesses their love to Choi Hyun wins 100 dollars. Uncomfortable with the vibe, Ju-Yeong leaves the party, only to run into Choi Hyun as he's breaking up with someone. Seizing the moment, Ju-Yeong blurts out:

"Go out with me too!"

But unlike the others, Ju-Yeong’s profession isn’t just a spur-of-the-moment gamble—he’s been secretly in love with Choi Hyun since high school. With Hyun caught off guard and no way to take it back, the two start dating that very night. Will Ju-Yeong’s long-time crush turn into a lasting relationship, or is this love destined to be just another fleeting romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Please Go Out With Me Too

186892.description:
In her younger days, Lee Hui-Jung was a well-known star actress. However, her life took a dramatic turn when her affair with 'Yeon Seon-Gu,' a popular film director and the husband of her close friend 'Kim Myeong-Hui,' was exposed. Subsequently, she faced a series of scandals following her friend's suicide and a traffic accident involving Yeon Seon-Gu.
As a result, Lee Hui-Jung left the entertainment industry, and 12 years passed. She received a tempting casting offer for a new film and, after much contemplation, decided to make her comeback in the film industry. But what she didn't expect was that the lead actress in the film would turn out to be 'Yeon Ji-Na,' the daughter of Kim Myeong-Hui and Yeon Seon-Gu...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: [Staff Only 短編選] 破倫劇～背徳の母娘～

186893.description:
Sometimes enslaved by money, sometimes by love— a bold new reinterpretation of those who become its slaves!

(Source: Toomics)

186894.description:
Kazuki finds out his same-age supervisor Itsuki is talented in bed, too...

Not only is Itsuki great at his job, his appearance and personality are flawless, too. Meanwhile, Kazuki is exceedingly average, and he can't help secretly envying Itsuki. But, one day, Kazuki learns some compromising information about Itsuki when the two happen to meet on a men's dating app! Kazuki takes a flustered Itsuki to a hotel and seduces him, enjoying his newfound sense of superiority.

At first, he'd only meant to tease, but now he can't get enough of his supervisor. Despite Kazuki's envy, their chemistry in bed is just too good! The dirty little secret they share only gets sweeter and sweeter...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Two Sides of an Envious Heart

title.english: Senior At Work, Junior In Bed
title.romaji: Netami Kokoro no Shiro to Kuro

186896.description:
Alicia Oslind is known as “The Frozen Lady.” She is seen as a villainess among the aristocrats because of her harsh words and haughty attitude that make people think the worst of her. In truth, she just has trouble being honest with her feelings… However, there is one person that she allows herself to befriend. The only one she allows into her heart is a boy named Gray, who works as a manservant in the mansion.

"You are the only one who understands me!"

Alicia becomes completely devoted to Gray, spoiling him to the hilt, at mealtimes, in the bathroom, and before bed! Because the lady is an aristocrat and Gray is a commoner, he must endure this doting love! An intense fantasy romantic comedy!

(Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)

title.native: 氷結令嬢さまをフォローしたら、メチャメチャ溺愛されてしまった件
title.romaji: Hyouketsu Reijou-sama wo Follow Shitara, Mechamecha Dekiaisarete Shimatta Ken

186897.description:
A man who died in a car accident was reincarnated as Silva Pierce in the world of the popular RPG Echoes of Eternity, which he had been playing before his death. Silva, the strongest knight of the kingdom with cheat-level stats, is a superb character who seems like the perfect target for reincarnation.

However, he is also a side-character destined to die protecting the protagonists at the end of the very first chapter…

Death events are inevitable, and if he abandons the protagonist party to run away, the world will be destroyed and game over! Silva, determined to avoid his doomed fate, begins to use his knowledge of the game in order to complete the game as fast as possible.

Will Silva be able to overcome his death event and survive?

(Source: Spira, translated)
synonyms: 銀の槍は砕けない　～一章終盤で死亡する序盤無双キャラに転生したハードコアゲーマーは超効率プレイで悲劇を打ち破る～
Since I Was Reincarnated Into the Strongest Side Character Who Dies Early on, I'll Use My Game Knowledge to Become Unrivaled

title.native: 序盤で死ぬ最強のサブキャラに転生したので、ゲーム知識で無双する
title.romaji: Joban de Shinu Saikyou no Sub Chara ni Tensei Shita no de, Game Chishiki de Musou Suru

186898.description:
Just as Haruchika Isezaki was confessing to his first love, he is suddenly summoned to another world. His summoner, the goddess Clementine, gives him an unusual mission: to make seven girls, destined to become the mothers of the next generation of heroes, fall in love again. These girls have lost their ability to love due to a curse cast by the Demon Lord. In other words, Haruchika must convince them all to fall in love with him!

To return to his world and hear the answer to his confession, Haruchika accepts this mission and sets out to save another world through love. Having mastered the art of romance through his study of female psychology, his journey to fulfill their first loves begins — a romantic tale about saving another world through the power of love!

(Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)
synonyms: A Love Manual You Can Use From Today

title.native: 今日から使える異世界恋愛マニュアル
title.romaji: Kyou Kara Tsukaeru Isekai Renai Manual

186899.description: Kingdom Bangai-hen is a side story of the Kingdom manga set during the Sanyou Aftermath Arc.

title.native: キングダム 番外編

186900.description:
Enter Heilbronner: gentleman thief! The main villain of a novel, who fought against the heroes, steals from the rich at night, but by day takes on the identity of Ludger Kassen, the philanthropic son of a duke, more interested in history than politics or power. As commander of the ragtag Ruby Knights, isekai’d knight Clara has no choice but to get involved in the Heilbronner case. However, in doing so, and in working alongside Ludger himself, Clara learns he secretly has far grander motives...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: It's a Misunderstanding That I'm Dating the Villain

186901.description:
Back when I was a student, my boyfriend dumped me out of nowhere. Ever since, though I'd love to be in a relationship, I just don't know what to do. This dry spell has run on for so long and looks set to continue now that I've graduated and started working.

I'm not brave enough to find a friend with benefits. Just as I was starting to think I'd never satisfy my cravings, my coworker told me about a place where you can chat with handsome, muscular men - Muscle Salon.

On the surface, what appeared to be a bar full of macho dudes turned out to be rife with men who, thanks to their flaws, are not particularly popular but are looking to take out their frustrations. If you get along particularly well, you can take advantage of the "After" service, where you can test drive your compatibility in both love and sex...

Misunderstood Muscle Men x Modest Wanting Woman
Discover the secrets hidden underneath those beautiful muscles and handsome faces.

(Source: DLcomics, translated)

title.native: マッスルサロンへようこそ!

186902.description:
Kail Black, a soldier stationed at an Antarctic research base, is assigned to support investigations into unexplained supernatural phenomena. But one morning, he wakes to a nightmare. The base has been overrun by monstrous organisms, and everyone is gone except for one man, Revo Keypling, who calmly introduces himself as a researcher. With no memory of what happened, Kail struggles to understand the disaster unfolding around them. But something even more disturbing begins to haunt him. Every night, he dreams of Revo, their bodies intertwined like wild animals, the visions so vivid that they leave him breathless when he wakes. And in those dreams, Revo always whispers the same chilling line, “Right here, this is where our baby will be born.”

Trapped in an isolated base, surrounded by impossible creatures, Kail begins to wonder which is more dangerous, the things lurking outside, or the man smiling beside him with secrets of his own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

186903.description:
Kwon Ji-Uk's monotonous daily life takes an unexpected turn at a club meeting when he becomes drawn to a mysterious new freshman. Captivated by the freshman's sweet looks, Ji-Uk tries to approach him, only to be met with a cold and dismissive attitude. Annoyed by the response, Ji-Uk resolves to teach the freshman a lesson in his own way. However, things take a shocking twist that Ji-Uk never saw coming. The next morning, Ji-Uk wakes up covered in someone else’s fluids, staring at an unfamiliar ceiling, only to realize he’s now trapped in an unimaginable and humiliating situation.

“You're all the same...how you let your urges take over...”

Once a domineering and fearsome figure who thrived on intimidation, Ji-Uk finds himself powerless against the alluring yet dangerous freshman, Park Ju-Yeon. With no clue about Juyeon’s true intentions or the deadly game that’s about to unfold, Ji-Uk is dragged into a personal hell designed just for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: 易地思之〜リベンジゲーム〜
เล่ห์ร้ายพลิกรัก

186904.description:
Satan is a first year student at Demon High, but he looks too pretty for a demon with his blue eyes and shiny white hair. Can Satan overcome his physical appearance to become a true demon or are we asking the wrong question?

(Source: Tapas, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

186905.description:
Dan and Lyla are two highly trained, elite assassins who work together on the most dangerous of missions. They've only ever interacted on the job, so when Dan suddenly confesses his love for Lyla, the two find themselves up against something they have zero training for: romance! With their lives and hearts on the line, can this killer couple continue breaking bones without breaking each other's hearts?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

186906.description:
Deserting the battlefield, Enoch Rubinstein flees with his newborn daughter Lilith to a small village to raise her disguised as James Brown, a regular, doting single father. But when the order of knights returns to drag Enoch back to the capital, Lilith finds that her father was secretly one of the empire's greatest heroes. As her father's daughter, she also discovers that she holds great potential. Will Lilith be able to keep her family safe? Or will the secrets lurking ahead overpower her?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: พ่อฉันไม่ธรรมดา

186907.description:
K-pop idol Yoon Eden has wasted away for years under a mediocre label with an incompetent CEO. He is disillusioned and on the verge of quitting when he's sent back in time to the day of his debut. Now, Eden is determined to use his songwriting talent to rewrite his career and gain some well-deserved fame. Despite his CEO still pushing cheesy songs and tacky concepts, can Eden, with the help of his group members, truly reignite his spark and become a sincerely dazzling idol?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: A Blank Slate Regression for the Idol That Lost His Original Mindset
初心を忘れたアイドルのための回帰白書

title.native: 초심 잃은 아이돌을 위한 회귀 백서
title.romaji: Chosim Ireun Idol-eul Wihan Hoegwi Baekseo

186908.description:
Nam Hae-Sul, who is handsome but famous for his dog-like personality, is only nice to his childhood friend, Yang Mi-Ru. "It's clear that he's nice to me because he likes me!" But is it really like that? Mi-Ru has no idea about Hae-Sul’s true feelings. Then one day, she finds out about the "black heart" that he harbors! Cracks are starting to appear in their 10-year friendship...! The wild growth story of a wolf boy and an innocent girl!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: オオカミ男子は幼なじみを食べたい

186909.description:
Rapunzel is a young girl who lives atop a tall tower and knows nothing of the outside world. One day she meets a boy named Mikel, who climbs the tower, and their destiny to change the world begins to unfold! The creators of "Oshi no Ko" and "Record of Ragnarok" form an incredible team to bring you the ultimate love story!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186915.description:
When high school boy Haru's cute little brother Makoto, is born, their mother has to be hospitalized for an extended period of time. So Haru's father, Mamoru, asks for help from his brother, the peculiar yet child-loving erotic-novel writer, Senya!? The story of three men parenting a baby unfolds!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

186916.description:
Hirakawa Kenichi is 70 years old and lives alone.

He was expecting a leisurely retirement, until he was suddenly hospitalized due to illness. He laments his circumstances and complains about the awful hospital food, but what keeps him going is reminiscing about the "delicious foods" he has eaten in his life.

His audience is a 29-year-old nurse who is confused about work, love, and life, as Hirakawa reflects on his life's journey through food.

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

186917.description:
"We have no use for weaklings here!"

"I will become a strong swordsman," but contrary to his childhood wish, Sora was banished from the Goken family, masters of the Genso Itto style of swordsmanship. Branded as useless and having lost everything, he becomes a “soul-eating dragon” and vows revenge!

(Source: Comic Earth Star, translated)
synonyms: The Revenge Of The Soul Eater

title.native: 反逆のソウルイーター -魂の捕食者と少女たち-
title.romaji: Hangyaku no Soul Eater: Tamashii no Hoshokusha to Shoujotachi

186918.description:
A war has upended the world's strict social order. The beast-woman Qing Shilun, a former high-ranking military officer, now finds herself banished to the lowest caste, given to her long-time rival Shen Xilan as a plaything. Everyone thought that Qing Shilun will be tortured and humiliated, but the game is just beginning, to see who will be the master and who will be tamed…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Officer, You Can No Longer Hide Your Tail

title.native: 长官，你的尾巴藏不住了
title.romaji: Zhangguan, Ni De Weiba Cang Bu Zhu Le

186919.description:
In your boring ordinary life, you suddenly meet an older girl who likes to talk about nothing in particular. The manga adaptation of a popular ASMR voice work that has been trending on social networking sites. This is a slice-of-life comedy with a mysterious big sister that will fill in the gaps in your heart.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: A Story Where a Gloomy Older Sister Feeds Me Worthless Lies Every Day

title.native: ダウナー系お姉さんに毎日カスの嘘を流し込まれる話
title.romaji: Downer-kei Oneesan ni Mainichi Kasu no Uso wo Nagashikomareru Hanashi

186921.description:
In a world where winter claims half the year, Haru Tamura, a florist's daughter, feels suffocated by her high school life of merely conforming to others. Her peaceful days are disrupted when she encounters a mysterious girl who repeatedly hibernates. This is a tale of small hopes blossoming in the hearts of 2 girls.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

186922.description:
In a world where one out of every 20 people in the human race has awakened to their “special ability,” Hiroto Takigami is one who has a seemingly useless ability to speak with spirits. For some reason, he is hated intensely by his stepsister Rei, who is one of the most powerful ability-wielders. She promises that the moment they graduate from the training institute and allowed to use their abilities freely, she will kill him. So Hiroto has only one year to live. Hiroto was in despair when a spirit appears to him and reveals the unexpected secret about his unique ability…

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.native: HACKING GHOST〜カラダにしか価値のない学園〜
title.romaji: HACKING GHOST: Karada ni Shika Kachi no Nai Gakuen

186923.description:
Zero grew up in an orphanage. Contrary to the orphanage's philosophy of "If you want it, believe in and fight for it," Zero hates competition and conflict and prefers peaceful days. However, after discovering a certain secret, Zero finds himself caught up in the whirlpool of a cruel fate...!?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

186924.description:
Yumeo is an incubus, but he is a loner at school. One day, Yumeo's mother, a succubus, tells him it's time to “lose his virginity.” So he tries to go after the gal who is rumored to be the biggest slut in class…? It's a cute and wholesome romantic comedy between a bitchy gal and a shy incubus!

(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

title.native: 名ばかりビッチと陰キャバス

186925.description: Newly written side story from Shiori Yomiuri's perspective, depicting her past.
synonyms: Days with my Step Sister: another days

186926.description:
“Will you stay with me until morning…?!”

I thought I had been reincarnated as the wicked wife, so why is he looking at me with such love?

One day, I found myself becoming Ilze, the villainess in a novel I had read before. Ilze is the lady who tries to disrupt the relationship between the protagonist Gilbert and the heroine, and her fate ends tragically with her banished to a brothel.

To avoid this dreadful fate, Ilze decides to peacefully ask Gilbert for a divorce. She thought that if she could change the story, she might be able to enjoy life in this new world. However, her plans didn’t go as expected, as Gilbert suddenly comes to her room and starts behaving in unpredictable ways.
synonyms: Your Grace, Please Leave Me Alone
Duke, please leave me alone as a bad wife.

title.english: Your Grace, Please Just Forget About This Wicked Wife!
title.native: 公爵様、悪妻の私はもう放っておいてください
title.romaji: Koushaku-sama, Akusai no Watashi wa Mou Houtteoite Kudasai

title.native: 公爵様、悪妻の私はもう放っておいてください
title.romaji: Koushaku-sama, Akusai no Watashi wa Mou Houtteoite Kudasai

186929.description:
An actor and a model walk into a gay bar... This sexy boys love romance takes place in the whirlwind world of TV stars and handsome celebrities! Popular actor Subaru Yuuki meets up-and-coming model Kaiho Kudo at a gay bar, and the two flirt and have a one-night stand. When Subaru's co-star is injured and forced to step down from the drama they're shooting, who should arrive to replace him but Kudo! Despite their recent fling and the obvious chemistry between them, Subaru must resist Kudo's advances because it's his personal policy not to get involved with cast members. Besides, he's not interested in a real relationship; he prefers to keep things no strings attached. Kudo, however, remains undeterred and makes a suggestion: what if, after the show is over, they become lovers?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

186934.description:
Due to a declining birth rate, pets are being transformed into humanoid members of society. But are they truly human? Or are humans truly animals?

When misanthrope Ao discovers her family dog, pit bull Taika, standing over the mauled body of her father, she must decide whether to forgive or forget. Ao isn't ready to lose both her beloved father and her devoted pet, so when her mother has Taika humanized, Ao embraces the new dogman and even brings him to school with her. There, Taika meets a German shepherd, an elite police dogman, and begins to unlearn canine behaviors and replace them with human customs. Now, the two dogmen compete to see who will be the first to track down the source of the mysterious traces of blood in Ao's locker…

(Source: VIZ Media)

186936.description:
"The kind of play I prefer is a little too hardcore for newbies."

Seo-Ha, a university lecturer, is a natural submissive with deeply ingrained masochistic tendencies. Yet, fear of being outed has kept him from ever pursuing a real partner, leaving him to indulge only in fantasies. When the fellow professor he has been secretly admiring announces their engagement, Seo-Ha is devastated. In a moment of impulsive rebellion, he turns to a BDSM community to find a one-night play partner, hoping to finally experience the domination he’s always craved. But this leap into the unknown may lead him down a path far more intense—and dangerous—than he ever imagined

(Source: Lezhin US)

186938.description:
Kang Yohan, plagued by endless misfortune, turns to the supernatural to change his luck. Too broke for a proper summoning ritual, he settles for a ""Do it Yourself"" version and ends up with Chung—a so-called ""cost-effective"" god.But life doesn’t come cheap. Yohan is about to learn two hard truths: you get what you pay for, and nothing comes without a price. Now, he must fulfill Chung’s bizarre conditions to finally escape his cursed fate!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.

186939.description:
Choi Kang, a key figure in the notorious “Seven” crime syndicate, reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Choi Leehan. Before they have a chance to mend their fractured bond, Leehan reveals his true identity: an undercover officer determined to dismantle the organization and free Kang from his criminal life. But behind his seemingly noble offer lies a hidden agenda. What could he truly be after?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.

Suffering from a thirst that can't be quenched with a one-off encounters, I'm still hooked on these dirty confessions.

My boyfriend Hikaru likes to push me around and treat me like his personal cocksleeve. My friends are always telling me I'm too naive and I need to break up with him. I don't understand why, though. After all, he's so cool and strong, and he knows how to bully me just the way I like it... ♥

(Source: Irodori Comics)

186945.description:
Yubi is a simple guy, who likes ramen and lives his life. One day he wakes up and finds a strange girl with a bowl of rice on her head in his house. Not understanding who she is, or where she came from, he asks her to leave. After, he finds that she was sitting near his door. She explains to him, that she is a fairy and is ready to take care of him, as his father was the King of Fairies. Yubi is shocked, but allows Lissie to stay.

(Source: Coolmic)

186947.description:
I used to be the toughest guy around, but ever since I caught the TS Virus and turned into a girl, everyone thinks they can treat me like shit! The only one who's still on my side is my dumb slut girlfriend, Miyu. She was nothing but a cocksleeve to me, but she's such an airheaded masochist that she actually liked the way I treated her, and she still thinks I was pushing her around because I love her or whatever. The problem is, she thinks all girls are masochist sluts like she is, and now she wants to "make me happy" by doing all the stuff I used to do to her! This is humiliating! I hate it! So why can't I say no to her...?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 104.

Yuuka’s feelings for Kaname continues to grow and she wants to take it further with him. Will this affect Mika and her affair with Kaname?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

186951.description:
Shay, the S-Class Hunter everyone dreams of becoming. But Dennis, a man with the power to switch bodies, sets his sights on stealing everything from him... by taking his body.

"You want my body? You'd be better off chasing youth."

(Source: DAYcomics)
synonyms: やり直しハンターのハーレム作り

186952.description:
Mysterious black circles have started appearing all over the world, and whoever falls in doesn't come back out. Then one day, a black circle swallows an entire school and everyone in it, turning it into a twisted maze of nightmares. Will Doyun and his classmates find a way out?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: 死の教室～44限目のサバイバル～

186954.description:
Salaryman Jin-Taek ends up living with his 20-year- old niece after a request from his sister-in-law. She looks so much like her mother that Jin-Taek, who's lived a life of discipline and restraint, finds himself slowly sinking into a swamp of desire. To make things worse, she keeps calling him "Dad"... and sneaks into his room every night.

"Dad, I want to do it with you."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

186955.description:
“Send me a DM at lunch. Pick the most secluded spot you know.”

Jeong-Han was enjoying his peaceful life as a high school teacher until he and the new student teacher, Chae-Rin, came to share their dirty secrets

(Source: DAYcomics)

synonyms: Simply One Hell of a Fiancée

186957.description:
The genius astronomer 'Woo Joo-Hyeok' dies. 15 years later, his resurrection android 'Ryu Seong-Woo' is created. Ryu Seong-Woo, who possesses Woo Joo-Hyeok's face and memories, loves Woo Joo-Hyeok's wife 'Ryu Byeol', but Ryu Byeol rejects him as just a robot... A twisted love story between a pianist who can no longer play the piano due to the trauma of losing her husband, and an android who lives forever despite being lifeless.

(Source: Naver, translated)

186958.description:
Sakurako, a shut-in and an obsessive fan of ero-ge (erotic fantasy games) hires a call-boy, Fuji, to try and experience the feelings of her favorite game character. Things go awry when a clumsy stumble causes the carefully-hidden otaku-ware and an erotic game on the TV to unpause—revealing Sakurako's ulterior motives. But it turns out that Fuji is a fan of the same game—so they end up spending the night playing games instead. The two keep in touch, and Sakurako is able to find the courage to go outside, if it means spending more time with Fuji (and fangirling out at a game-themed cafe!).

(Source: Kodansha USA)

186959.description:
What does it take for an animal to live and survive? What would it choose to die for? A T. rex, washed ashore and stranded on an island for over 20 years, waits for the day he can take his final breath. But just when that moment seems near, hope arrives.

A collection of stories about the great creatures that have roamed the Earth before us.

(Source: WEBTOON)

186961.description:
Woo-Ri Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Su-Bin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woo-Ri wakes up back in high school, right beside Su-Bin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Su-Bin’s hands, Woo-Ri becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woo-Ri finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Su-Bin’s happiness. With just one life left, Woo-Ri sets out to give Su-Bin the happiest life possible.

(Source: WEBTOON)

186962.description:
What if you could undo your dark past? Chaebom Yu, a burned-out office worker, wakes up as her 17-year-old self, given a second chance to rewrite her life. She enters high school determined to avoid the mistakes that once haunted her. But the more she tries to fix things, the weirder her life becomes. Money starts slipping away, and strange boys keep showing up… Her “do-over” begins to feel just as messy as before! Can Chaebom truly escape her past, or is she just trading one chaotic life for another?

(Source: WEBTOON)

186963.description:
Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world’s top MMORPG, using her brother’s account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she’s mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who’s secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait… I know this girl!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ไอดอลประจำกิลด์

186964.description:
In a world where werewolves live among humans in secret, Ji-u Han, a detective agency owner and a powerful werewolf, crosses paths with Yuseung Cheon, a famous actor, when he “accidentally” hits her with his car. And when they run into each other again “by chance,” one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him —whatever that may entail. Ji-u wants Yuseung’s rare ability to make werewolves stronger through touch. Yuseung, on the other hand, wants information on key figures in the werewolf world to eliminate them. Will they each get what they’re after? Or more importantly—will they fall in love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

186966.description:
"Is it really this hard, just because of me?"

After finishing his military service, Gi-Chan develops a strange condition. Once he gets hard, he doesn't go down until he cums. And when he finally does? He releases an explosive amount of cum. With this dangerous condition, Gi-Chan returns to his hometown... where a seductive new family is waiting for him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

186967.description:
After a messy breakup with a trashy ex forces I-Hyeon Seon to take a three-year-long break from college, the last thing she wants to do upon her not-so-inconspicuous return is to dive straight into another relationship. But then comes Chan-U Nam, a notorious bad boy who finds himself having a vested interest in I-Hyeon. And suddenly, what was supposed to be a low-key senior year is looking like it's going to be anything but. The harder I-Hyeon pushes Chan-U away, the stronger he keeps pulling her back. But something’s gotta give – so who’s giving in first?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

186968.description:
"Koyomi Gonomi" is a story that anthropomorphizes the calendar, including New Year's Day and New Year's Eve. In the past, at the end of the year in Japan, Omisoka and New Year's Day would descend into the human world and set the "gears of time" in motion, allowing people to feel the passage of the year. However, as the eras progressed from Showa to Heisei to Reiwa, the concept of New Year's Eve became a mere formality, and New Year's Day, now in human form, ended up working part-time at a convenience store. Furthermore, when the gears of time are in danger of stopping, Omisoka struggles to help New Year's Day remember its former self.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

186969.description:
Maria, Empress of Rastonia, is betrayed by her husband Emperor Henry after his mistress gives birth to a son. King Helland the Great, ruler of a neighboring kingdom, takes her as collateral so that Henry can have one more year to repay a considerable debt. King Helland is actually Gunther Preisley, a former slave for Maria’s family. He has loved her a decade and is determined to woo her. Meanwhile, back in Rastonia, two different women vie to replace her as Empress. Will Maria survive the year so that she can avenge herself, and will Gunther win her heart?

(Source: WEBTOON)

186970.description:
After his shaman grandfather passes away, Yoon Dam suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts—a gift he would rather not have. The only solution? The power of a goblin. Enter Lee Do-Han, who claims to be exactly that. But there’s a catch: every time Do-Han tries to harm Yoon Dam, mysterious wounds appear on his own body instead. Intrigued by this bizarre connection, Do-Han proposes a deal: “Why not just let me be your tutor?” Bound by strange circumstances and their own hidden agendas, the two set off on a journey neither of them could have imagined…

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Sato receives a report that new employee Shiomi isn't doing his job, he goes to check on him, only to find that for some reason he's cooking dinner in the tea room...!? A gentle and delicious break in the office!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

186976.description:
Emi, a depressed girl who lost her mother, moves to Enoshima, where her aunt lives. Dragons fly around Enoshima, and she has been able to see them since she was a child. One day, Emi sees a large dragon and a small dragon that she once saw with her mother descend on the island. She chases after them and finds that there are a human brother and sister...

(Source: Natalie, translate)

186977.description:
Childhood friends Ahn Do-Hun and Woo Ik-Su have been inseparable since elementary school, bonded by their shared love for the mid-tier baseball team, the Dolphins. But when Ik-Su decides to go to the team’s home opener with someone other than Do-Hun, the foundations of their friendship begin to crack. With this curveball, their relationship takes an unexpected turn…and as the Dolphins edge closer to a championship, Do-Hun and Ik-Su can’t seem to get one another off their minds. Will their relationship be able to make a comeback in the final inning? Or did Ik-Su’s foul play ruin his chance at scoring with Do-Hun forever…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes eight side story chapters.
synonyms: ปีนี้จะไม่เหมือนเดิม

186978.description:
Yiram is a half-breed vampire. Which sounds pretty mysterious and grand, but it’s nothing glamorous. He’s a fairly regular guy working as a middle school art teacher, and he doesn’t even drink blood. Mostly because he has a teeny tiny trauma regarding blood, but that’s not important. Hardly memorable…until Hong Jua, the very root of that trauma, becomes his coworker. There’s no way this can go wrong, right?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side story chapters.
synonyms: รักนี้ต้องการเลือด

186979.description:
Ritsu, a young man who has fallen on hard times following the death of his father, a famous chef, meets a dull middle-aged man with amnesia through an unlicensed part-time job.

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)
synonyms: An Underdog and a Court Chef

186980.description:
While working overtime, Ji-Chan Choi happens to stumble upon the 'Office Romance Registry.' Out of curiosity, he writes his name in the manager's column. From that day on, his life begins to change... 'Office romance is forbidden in our company. However, managers are excluded.'

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

186981.description:
Physician Roger Baldwin, a member of one of the five great houses, is forced on pain of death to transplant a Philosopher’s Stone into a human heart—and after 10 failed attempts, he finally succeeds! At the age of 18, the recipient, Mahoro Baldwin, is sent to the Lowen Royal Officers Academy to study magic, and to discover the fate of his adoptive brother and bosom friend Siegfried. But when he arrives on the Isle of Crimson, he soon realizes he has much more to learn than a few spells. At once intimidated and fascinated by the gorgeous upperclassmen Noah St. Johns, Mahoro is drawn ever deeper into a web of intrigue and attraction that he barely comprehends…

This magic academy drama unfolds in a gothic fantasy kingdom simmering with class conflict and sexual tension…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

186986.description:
In a seaside town, a young girl living with her fisherman grandfather encounters a mysterious blue-eyed young man on the day of a great tide. He claims to be searching for a mermaid. Several years later, he appears before her again, looking exactly the same as before. Then, on the night of another great tide, she is mysteriously drawn into the sea.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

186987.description: Before I knew it, they had already run far ahead—!?
synonyms: I can't catch up with this love

title.native: この恋には追いつけない

186988.description:
Aoshima, a rookie food officer of the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force, is assigned to the "Submarine Fleet," a unit known for its harsh and special conditions. Aoshima begins working without confidence, but after coming into contact with the personalities of his senior food officer chief Tachibana and the other members of the unit, he becomes more positive about his work. A fleet gourmet drama that depicts the people who work underwater!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

186989.description:
Melanie, a member of the prestigious Stewart family, is a "dropout" with little magic power. When her engagement is called off because of her lack of magical powers, she finds herself in the library, where she succeeds in deciphering an ancient lost language!
However, when her uncle invites her to a magic school, Quinn, the best court magician in the country, discovers her hidden talent...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 宮廷魔術師の婚約者　書庫にこもっていたら、国一番の天才に見初められまして！？

186990.description:
From their humble beginnings as Class 1-D, Horikita and her classmates now begin their third year as Class 3-A—but the battle isn’t over yet. With only one year left until graduation, there’s no room for even the smallest failure. And not only will they have to fight harder than ever, they’ll have to do it without their most influential person: Ayanokouji Kiyotaka. Amid the chaos of losing Ayanokouji to Class C, Horikita’s class finds itself faced with one cruel truth: If they can’t defeat Ayanokouji, they don’t stand a chance to graduate from Class A. Does Horikita’s class have what it takes, or is their time at the top doomed to be short-lived?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ　３年生編
title.romaji: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e: 3-nensei-hen

186991.description:
On his way home from a coworker's wedding, Hasumi buys a seedling in hopes of leading a lush life after witnessing the happy bride and groom. While growing the overpriced and labor-intensive plant, he overhears talk of the smitten newlywed at the office. He drops the plant in the bathtub one day, and when he returns home the next, he finds that the plant has soaked up a considerable amount of water and grown twice as large. After continually adding more water over time, the plant finally reaches the point where it spills forth from the tub and a humanoid man emerges from its leaves. Hasumi keeps his distance at first, but after becoming accustomed to their life together and catching a glimpse of the plant man's cock, he takes action.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

186992.description:
In addition to the original short story and doujinshi manuscript of "Can't Resist a Lonely Girl," which depicts Ayaka and Sora as university students, this book includes all of the other short stories to date! A collection of yuri short stories filled with the sparkle of youth and the excitement of first love★

[Included works]
1. Marking
2. That's Just How I Love You
3. Can't Defy the Lonely Girl More!
4. Oafs in Love
5. Don't You Like Me Too?
6. My White Rose
7. The Demon Disappears Through a Lens
8. Hanaya no Ano Hito
9. Sweeter Than The Taste Of Alcohol
10. Osananajimi no Trophy
11. The Two of Us Are One, So
12. A One-Word Love Letter

title.native: ロンリーガールに花束を 樫風短編集
title.romaji: Lonely Girl ni Hanataba wo Kashikaze Tanpenshuu

186993.description:
Minori, 40 years old, single, president of a design company, thought that he knew by now how to hide his feelings and handle his life. But then, at a friend's wedding, he met his old business partner Takuya and one touch of his was enough to undo him. "You're like an old married couple," people around them would joke. But were they really? And how does one even begin to navigate a relationship between two men like them?

(Source: Julian publishing, translated)

Notes:
- Original serialization ran for seven chapters. In the volume release, Chapters 6 and 7 were combined as Chapter 6.
- Includes three extra chapters.

186994.description:
Sung Hye-Min, a senior associate at B-SAM (Bureau of Supernatural Ability Management), is on the verge of completing his final task for promotion when he’s suddenly assigned a rookie, Lee Jee-Yoon.

"I pulled a few strings to get in here so I could see you."

"...You pulled strings to land this job? Why?!"

With his long-awaited promotion at stake, Hye-Min must navigate the chaos of mentoring this unexpected rookie from the above...!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.
synonyms: [Hagguksang Short Story Collection] Please Take Care of My Parachute!
[Downfall Collection] A Rookie From the Above

186995.description:
Ao lives with his father, who has a bad drinking habit, in a town with a beautiful view of the sea. He spends his time trying to be as inconspicuous as possible, both at his high school and at home, as if he's holding his breath. One day, while on the way home from school, he meets Minato smoking a cigarette on the station platform. Minato, who works at a bento shop in spite of his blonde hair and piercings, can't stand the fact that Ao eats food from the convenience store every day, so he offers him a suggestion: "Instead of making you a bento every day, comment on my cooking"...?

The story of two young men who meet in a seaside town, and their once-in-a-lifetime true love.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I saw the sea on the morning the world began
We saw the sea on the morning the world began

title.native: 世界が始まる朝に海を見た
title.romaji: Sekai ga Hajimaru Asa ni Umi wo Mito

186996.description:
Tiga Cantik (based on the rap duo hy4_4yh), is a mischievous but kind monster girl who has lived in the forests of Bali for a long time. This is a story of action, laughter, and tears as she protects girls from the misfortunes that befall them.

(Source: Homesha, translated)
synonyms: ティガチャンティック ~ 3匹の妖怪少女～

title.native: ティガチャンティック

186997.description:
The good go to World One, the bad go to World Two, and the others await God's judgment in World Three. 19-year-old Yoon Cheol never questioned this system... until her sister, Jung, was taken to World Two for an unknown crime. Determined to uncover what that crime was, Cheol ventures to the boundary area between World Two and World Three, which is guarded by God's powerful subordinates. But with no special skills or knowledge of the world beyond her own, can Cheol hope to succeed?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 三つの世界～神の審判に抗え～

186998.description: A fashion designer crosses paths with the "Prince of Alterations" at a famous department store?

186999.description:
Two classmates sit next to each other every day, but they’ve never spoken even once. One day, after a haircut mishap, one of them finally gathers the courage to start a conversation…!? A heart-fluttering love story between two innocent souls! ♡♡

(Source: Betsufure, translated)

title.native: わかりにくいね佐野くんは
